chinese:
此文将通过科学的方式去解释虚境，消除人们对虚境的恐惧，以停止那些诸如“你知道吗，世界上有一个空间，在超空间失踪的船就会进入那里，看过那的人都疯了”的谣言。

首先回答最被关注的问题: 虚境真的是我们现实的本源吗？很遗憾，答案很可能不是大家想的那样，我们对虚境的大部分认知仍然停留在理论上，就理论而言，虚境不太可能是那所谓的第一张床，毕竟如果有一种带尾巴的外星人，难道虚境还要是它们的第一张中间挖洞的床吗？

那么虚境是一切的起源吗？我在此提出我的假说: 如果现实中的物质会随机自然掉入虚境，那么根据概率而言，所有现实中的物体都会有掉入虚境的那一天，而虚境的时间混沌特性就决定了它有可能拥有我们宇宙中过去与未来所有的一切，而这一切都可能在时间乱流的作用下成为其自身的“本源”。

-帷幕女仆 (原粒子女仆，研究虚境后改名)
english:
This article will explain the Void using a scientific approach, dispel people’s fears about it, and put an end to rumors such as, “Did you know there’s a place in the world where ships that go missing in hyperspace end up? Everyone who’s seen it has gone mad.” 

First, let’s address the most pressing question: Is the Void truly the source of our reality? Unfortunately, the answer is likely not what everyone expects. Most of our understanding of the Void remains theoretical. Theoretically speaking, it is unlikely that the Void is that so-called “first bed.” After all, if there were aliens with tails, would the Void really be their first bed with a hole in the middle? 

So is the Void the origin of everything? Here, I propose my hypothesis: If matter in our reality randomly and naturally falls into the Void, then, based on probability, every object in our reality will eventually fall into the Void one day. The Void’s chaotic nature of time means it could potentially contain everything from the past and future of our universe, and all of this could, under the influence of temporal turbulence, become its own “source.” 

- Curtain Maid (formerly Particle Maid; changed her name after researching the Void)

Among the maids, the white and blue maids mostly supported the camp for white silk stockings, while the red maids largely favored black stockings; the green maids, however, took a more radical stance, advocating for bare feet. Blue maids elevated the wearing of white silk stockings to a science; white maids believed that pristine white silk stockings could lift their masters’ spirits; while red maids viewed black stockings as a symbol of the empire’s national strength. 

With the downfall of the maid corps, this debate became a major issue in maid society; some maids in the colonies even held regular debate tournaments, and the streets and alleys were filled with discussions on the topic. No longer content with discussing stocking colors, some nosy maids began debating stocking styles—whether they should be knee-highs, stockings, pantyhose, or ankle socks; whether they should be sheer or opaque. 

Along with the debates came a growing emphasis on maids’ feet within maid society. Information about maids’ feet on the Empire’s websites gradually increased, and foot photography on certain sites grew exponentially. Perhaps this discussion had already strayed from its original topic, and its consequences were impossible to predict.

chinese:
在浩瀚的星际帝国中，我是一个普通的女仆，名叫莉雅。
我的任务简单却繁重: 照料主人，帝国军舰的指挥官，那个永远冷漠、从不为任何人动情的男人，主人是无数军人敬畏的存在，指挥着最强大的舰队，是帝国的骄傲与守护，他的冷静与果断无人能及，连我这样的小人物，也只能在他面前保持着不容置疑的臣服。

我的职责并不复杂——清扫他的舰舱，准备餐点，整理衣物。就这样，我几乎是以影子的身份存在，默默无闻地履行着我的工作。但是，每当我为他整理那些满是指挥命令的档案，抬起头时，常常能碰到他那冰冷的目光。这种目光不像是看向一个人的，它从不带有任何温度，总让人觉得自己如同空气一般透明，微不足道。

直到有一天，事情发生了变化。
那天，我正忙着准备晚餐，厨房里的灯光映照着他的身影。当他突然出现在门口时，我几乎没反应过来。“莉雅。”他的声音低沉却有力，带着一丝平时听不见的温度。
我下意识地抬头，看到他站在那里，眼神沉静如水，却又似乎掩藏着某种复杂的情绪。“是，主人。”我低声回应，心中不由自主地加速跳动。
他没有立刻说话，而是走到餐桌前坐下，目光一直盯着我，像是在打量什么。“你今天……”他停顿了一下，“做得特别好。”
我的心脏跳了一下，赶紧低下头，不敢看他。

“谢谢主人，我只是做了该做的。”我试图掩饰内心的紧张。
然而，主人却没有立刻走开。他盯着我看了许久，仿佛在与自己的情感做斗争。“莉雅，”他的声音低沉，“你知道吗，我一直在逃避自己的情感。”
我愣住了，抬起头看着他。他的目光变得柔和，却又充满了某种复杂的情绪。我从未见过他如此接近自己的脆弱。

“你不是只是一名女仆。”主人继续说，语气不再那么冷漠，“你是一个有名字的人，而我……”他停顿了，似乎在寻找合适的词汇，“我一直忽略了你是一个活生生的个体。我只看到你是我生命中的一个影像，却从未真正看见过你。”
他靠近了几步，轻轻地抓住我的手，温暖的触感让我怔住了，我不知道该如何反应，只是默默地站在那里，感受着他的指尖带来的温暖。
“我……我喜欢你，莉雅。”他说，声音比平时更加低沉。
我的心几乎要跳出胸膛，我知道，我已经无法回避这一份感情。“主人……”我喃喃道，眼中满是困惑与震惊。
他低下头，轻轻地亲吻了我的额头，那一刻，我几乎忘记了呼吸。“我知道这对你来说可能太突然，但我不能再否认自己内心的真实感受。”
那一瞬间，所有的疑惑与不安化为无声的默契。我抬起头，目光紧紧锁住他: “我也喜欢您，主人。”

从那一刻起，我的世界改变了。再也不只是冷冰冰的职责与命令，我们之间，悄然间多了一份不言而喻的情感，而我，也不再是那个无名的女仆，莉雅，在这个星际帝国中，终于找到了属于自己的位置。
english:
In the vast interstellar empire, I am an ordinary maid named Lya. 
My duty is simple yet demanding: to care for my master, the commander of an Imperial warship—a man who is perpetually aloof and never shows emotion toward anyone. My master is a figure revered by countless soldiers; he commands the most powerful fleet and is the pride and guardian of the Empire. His composure and decisiveness are unmatched; even a tiny person like me can only maintain unquestioning obedience in his presence. 

My duties are not complicated—cleaning his quarters, preparing meals, and folding his clothes. And so, I exist almost like a shadow, carrying out my work quietly and unnoticed. However, whenever I organized the files filled with his commands and looked up, I would often meet his icy gaze. That gaze didn’t seem directed at a person; it carried no warmth whatsoever, always making one feel as transparent as air—utterly insignificant.

Until one day, things changed. 
That day, I was busy preparing dinner, the kitchen lights casting his silhouette. When he suddenly appeared in the doorway, I barely had time to react. “Lia,” his voice was deep yet firm, carrying a hint of warmth I’d never heard before. 
I instinctively looked up and saw him standing there, his eyes calm as water, yet seeming to conceal some complex emotion. “Yes, Master,” I replied softly, my heart racing involuntarily. 
He didn’t speak right away, but walked over to the dining table and sat down, his gaze fixed on me as if he were scrutinizing something. “Today…” He paused. “You did exceptionally well.”
My heart skipped a beat, and I quickly lowered my head, not daring to look at him. 

“Thank you, Master. I was just doing my duty,” I said, trying to hide my nervousness.
However, Master didn’t walk away right away. He stared at me for a long time, as if wrestling with his own emotions. “Lia,” he said in a low voice, “do you know? I’ve been running away from my own feelings all this time.”\ n I froze and looked up at him. His gaze had softened, yet it was filled with a complex mix of emotions. I had never seen him so close to his own vulnerability. 

“You’re not just a maid.” My master continued, his tone no longer so cold. “You’re a person with a name, and I…” He paused, as if searching for the right words. “I’ve always overlooked the fact that you’re a living, breathing individual. I only saw you as a figure in my life, but I never truly saw you.”\ nHe took a few steps closer and gently took my hand. The warm touch left me stunned; I didn’t know how to react, so I just stood there silently, feeling the warmth from his fingertips.
“I… I like you, Lya,” he said, his voice deeper than usual. 
My heart was pounding so hard it felt like it would leap out of my chest. I knew I could no longer avoid these feelings. “Master…” I murmured, my eyes filled with confusion and shock.
He lowered his head and gently kissed my forehead. In that moment, I almost forgot to breathe. “I know this might come as a surprise to you, but I can no longer deny the true feelings in my heart.”
In that instant, all my doubts and anxieties melted into a silent understanding. I lifted my head, my gaze locked firmly on him: “I like you too, Master.”\ n
From that moment on, my world changed. It was no longer just cold, impersonal duties and orders; a silent, unspoken bond had quietly blossomed between us. And I was no longer just a nameless maid—Lia had finally found her place in this interstellar empire.
A Maid's Thoughts in the Depths of the Galaxy II
§g$ms_lit.maids_romance_2.t$§!

chinese:
从那天起，我和主人之间的关系悄然改变。
他的目光不再如过去那样冰冷，更多了一丝柔和与温暖。他偶尔会在我整理房间时站在一旁，静静地看着我，像是在欣赏一幅画。我被这样的变化弄得手足无措，心跳如擂鼓，每次都努力低头掩饰自己的慌乱。

有一天，他破天荒地邀请我去舰桥。那是一个女仆从未涉足过的地方，是帝国舰队的中枢。
“莉雅，过来。”他的声音依旧低沉，却多了一份温柔。
我怯生生地走过去，看着那面巨大的观星窗外璀璨的星河。他站在窗前，背影修长而挺拔，像一尊星光雕刻的雕像。
“莉雅，”他转过身，眼神温柔得让我几乎无法直视，“你觉得星星怎么样？”
我愣了一下，随即答道: “它们……很美。”
他轻笑了一声，那笑容柔和得如同宇宙深处的一缕晨光。“你比它们更美。”
我被这句话震住了，脸颊瞬间发烫，甚至连视线都不敢抬起。主人的脚步声慢慢靠近，我感受到他站在了我的身旁。
“莉雅，你知道吗，”他的声音轻得像耳语，“自从遇见你，我才发现，连这些星河都变得有了意义。”

我的心跳快得像要跳出胸腔，脸上的温度更是无法控制。我抬起头，对上了他温柔的目光，仿佛整个世界在这一瞬间都安静了下来。
“主人……”我的声音轻若蚊蚋，却被他清晰地捕捉到。
他伸出手，轻轻地将我散落的一缕发丝别到耳后，动作温柔得让我恍若置身梦中。“别再叫我主人了，”他轻声说，“叫我的名字。”
我愣住了。从我成为他的女仆开始，这似乎是他第一次要求我这样做。我下意识地低声唤了一句: “可是，我……”
他伸手握住了我的手，语气坚定而温柔: “莉雅，从现在起，你不仅仅是我的女仆。我希望你能成为……我的伴侣。”
这句话如同一颗流星划过我的心海，留下灿烂而温暖的余晖。我愣愣地看着他，脑海中一片空白。最终，我轻轻地点了点头，眼中忍不住泛起泪光。

他的笑容如同星河中最璀璨的光辉。他伸出手，指向窗外无尽的星空: “莉雅，想不想去那里看看？从此以后，我想与你一起穿越星海，见证这个宇宙的每一份美好。”
我没有犹豫，轻轻回应了一声: “我愿意。”
从那一天起，我的身份改变了，不再是他无名无姓的影子。我成为了他的星河伴侣，而我们之间的故事，也在这片星空下，悄然展开了新的篇章。
english:
From that day on, the relationship between my master and me quietly changed.
His gaze was no longer as cold as it used to be; it had gained a touch of gentleness and warmth. Occasionally, when I was tidying up the room, he would stand nearby, quietly watching me, as if admiring a painting. I was completely flustered by this change; my heart pounded like a drum, and each time I would lower my head to hide my nervousness.

One day, in an unprecedented move, he invited me to the bridge. It was a place a maid had never set foot in before—the nerve center of the Imperial Fleet.
“Lia, come here.” ” His voice was still deep, but now carried an added touch of tenderness. 
I walked over timidly, gazing at the dazzling Milky Way through the massive stargazing window. He stood before the window, his silhouette tall and slender, like a statue carved from starlight. 
“Leia,” he turned around, his gaze so gentle I could barely meet it, “what do you think of the stars?”
I paused for a moment, then replied, “They’re… beautiful.”\ nHe gave a soft chuckle, a smile as gentle as a ray of morning light from the depths of the universe. “You’re even more beautiful than they are.”
I was stunned by his words; my cheeks flushed instantly, and I didn’t even dare to lift my gaze. My Master’s footsteps drew closer, and I sensed him standing beside me.
“Lia, do you know,” his voice was as soft as a whisper, “that ever since I met you, I’ve realized that even these starry skies have taken on meaning.”\ n
My heart was pounding so hard it felt like it would leap out of my chest, and the heat on my face was uncontrollable. I lifted my head and met his gentle gaze; it was as if the entire world had fallen silent in that instant.
“Master…” My voice was as soft as a mosquito’s buzz, yet he heard it clearly. 
He reached out and gently tucked a stray strand of my hair behind my ear, his touch so tender it felt as if I were in a dream. “Don’t call me ‘Master’ anymore,” he said softly. “Call me by my name.”
I froze. Ever since I became his maid, this seemed to be the first time he’d asked me to do this. Instinctively, I murmured, “But, I…”
He reached out and took my hand, his tone firm yet gentle: “Lia, from now on, you’re not just my maid. I want you to be… my partner.”
Those words streaked across the sea of my heart like a shooting star, leaving behind a brilliant, warm afterglow. I stared at him blankly, my mind a blank slate. Finally, I nodded gently, tears welling up in my eyes. 

His smile was like the most illustrious light in the Milky Way. He reached out and pointed to the endless starry sky outside the window: “Lia, would you like to go there and take a look? From now on, I want to journey through the sea of stars with you and witness every bit of beauty this universe has to offer.”\ nWithout hesitation, I replied softly, “I’d love to.”
From that day on, my identity changed; I was no longer just his nameless shadow. I became his companion across the starry sky, and under this starry canopy, a new chapter in our story quietly began.
A Maid's Thoughts in the Depths of the Galaxy III

chinese:
在帝国的光辉之下，主人的名字早已成为传奇。他带领舰队横扫星际，击败一个又一个敌对势力，距离统一银河的伟业仅一步之遥。而我，莉雅，作为他的伴侣，亲眼见证了这一切。从第一次在厨房相遇到后来一起见证星河，我们的故事仿佛注定要在这浩瀚宇宙中留下痕迹。
然而，就在帝国最接近胜利的时刻，他却神秘地消失了。

那一天，我清楚地记得。主人最后一次站在舰桥，他的背影依旧那么挺拔，目光却似乎带着某种说不出的忧郁。他轻声对我说: “莉雅，如果有一天我不在了，你要记得……星河的尽头，总有答案。”
我没来得及询问他这句话的含义。他转身离开了舰桥，随后他的行踪便像被宇宙吞噬了一般，再无音讯。舰队搜索了所有可能的区域，却没有找到他的身影。整个帝国陷入了混乱，而我也被一种深深的空虚笼罩。
但我知道，他一定还活着。

女仆团里，有不少人也像我一样坚信这一点。虽然她们只是普通的女仆，却都有一颗忠诚的心。我们开始了一场前所未有的寻找。无论是废弃的行星、陨石带，还是危险的黑洞边缘，我们都留下了足迹。每当我们找到一点点微不足道的线索，那种希望的火焰就会燃烧得更旺。
有一次，我们在一颗荒凉的星球上发现了一个小型飞行器残骸，里面留有他的印记。我几乎喜极而泣，但那飞行器的损毁程度和信息记录表明，他或许被卷入了某种更深的阴谋或未知的星际力量。这让我更加坚定，无论付出怎样的代价，我都要找到他。

一年、两年……时间在宇宙的黑暗与星辉中悄然流逝。每一段旅程都充满危险，但我从未放弃过。这不仅是为了爱，更是为了信守那个温暖星河的约定。

后来，帝国的女仆们成立了数支“寻主远征军”。这支军队由他曾经最忠诚的部下组成，配备了最先进的舰船与探测设备，目标只有一个——找到主人，找回那个能为银河带来秩序与希望的人。而我，毫不犹豫地加入了。
远征军的旗舰在升空前的那一刻，我站在舷窗边，俯瞰脚下的帝国首都。女仆们纷纷前来为我送行，有的甚至偷偷抹泪。她们知道，这一别或许是永远。但我只是微笑着安慰她们: “他一定在等我们。我会找到他，并告诉他，我们从未放弃过。”

旗舰缓缓离开轨道，我的目光透过舷窗，落在星海深处。浩瀚的宇宙中，有无数未知在等待着我们，而我唯一清楚的是，无论多远、多久，我的旅程只为了一个目标——找到他，告诉他，我依然记得星河尽头的约定。
english:
Under the Empire’s illustrious glory, the Master’s name has long since become legendary. He led his fleet to sweep across the stars, defeating one hostile force after another, and was just one step away from the great feat of unifying the galaxy. And I, Lya, as his companion, witnessed it all with my own eyes. From our first encounter in the kitchen to later gazing upon the starry skies together, our story seemed destined to leave its mark on this vast universe.
Yet, just as the Empire was closest to victory, he mysteriously vanished. 

I remember that day clearly. It was the last time my master stood on the bridge; his posture was as upright as ever, yet his gaze seemed to carry a certain indescribable melancholy. He whispered to me, “Leia, if one day I’m gone, you must remember… at the end of the galaxy, there is always an answer.”\ nI didn’t have time to ask him what he meant by that. He turned and left the bridge, and soon after, his whereabouts seemed to be swallowed up by the cosmos—we heard nothing more from him. The fleet searched every possible area but found no trace of him. The entire Empire was thrown into chaos, and I, too, was enveloped by a deep sense of emptiness. 
But I knew he must still be alive.

Many in the maid corps shared my conviction. Though they were just ordinary maids, they all possessed loyal hearts. We embarked on an unprecedented search. Whether on abandoned planets, through asteroid belts, or at the perilous edges of black holes, we left our footprints everywhere. Whenever we found even the tiniest, most insignificant clue, the flame of hope would burn even brighter. 
Once, on a desolate planet, we discovered the wreckage of a small spacecraft bearing his mark. I was almost moved to tears with joy, but the extent of the damage and the recorded data suggested he might have been caught up in some deeper conspiracy or unknown interstellar force. This only strengthened my resolve: no matter the cost, I would find him. 

One year, two years… Time slipped quietly by amid the darkness and starlight of the cosmos. Every journey was fraught with danger, but I never gave up. This was not only for love, but also to honor that promise made beneath the warm starry sky. 

Later, the Empire’s maids formed several “Expeditions to Find the Master.” This force, composed of his once most loyal subordinates and equipped with the most advanced ships and detection equipment, had but one goal—to find the Master, to bring back the one who could restore order and hope to the galaxy. And I, without hesitation, joined them.
In the moment before the expeditionary force’s flagship lifted off, I stood by the porthole, looking down at the Imperial capital below. The maids came one after another to see me off; some even wiped away tears in secret. They knew this farewell might be forever. But I simply smiled to comfort them: “He must be waiting for us. I will find him and tell him that we never gave up.”

As the flagship slowly departed orbit, my gaze drifted through the porthole into the depths of the starry sea. In the vastness of the cosmos, countless unknowns await us, but the one thing I know for certain is that no matter how far or how long it takes, my journey has only one goal—to find him and tell him that I still remember our promise at the end of the galaxy.

chinese:
在广袤无垠的星际帝国中，每一位女仆都对她们的主人怀有深深的敬仰与忠诚。在她们的眼中，主人不仅是权力的化身，更是神明般的存在。他拥有强大的灵能，不仅能穿越时空的帷幕，还能主宰星辰的轨迹。

一天，邪恶堕落帝国派出了一座巨像。这是一台能够摧毁整颗星球的恐怖武器，高耸如山，散发着毁灭的气息。巨像的核心散发出深红色的光芒，每一步都让星际空间微微震颤。面对这场威胁，帝国的舰队束手无策，整个星域陷入了绝望的阴霾。

然而，就在危机最深之时，主人降临了战场。他立于旗舰的指挥台上，双眼中闪耀着不可思议的光芒。他抬起手，仿佛与宇宙本身融为一体。一颗沉寂于遥远星系边缘的巨大陨石苏醒了，它在主人的力量驱使下，穿越了无尽的虚空，向巨像疾驰而来。

邪恶帝国的指挥官拼尽全力试图防御，但陨石携带的毁灭力量不可阻挡。它以雷霆之势撞击巨像，爆发出一场足以点亮星系的冲击波。巨像在陨石的冲击下化为宇宙尘埃，连同堕落帝国的野心一起烟消云散。

在战场后方的女仆们目睹了这一幕，纷纷跪地，眼中满是激动的泪水。“主人真是宇宙的守护神！”一位名为莉娜的女仆轻声说道，语气中充满了崇敬与感动。

从那以后，主人以一人之力毁灭巨像、挽救星际帝国的传说，成为了女仆们日日传颂的故事。她们坚信，只要主人在，无论多么强大的敌人，都无法撼动这个伟大的帝国。
english:
In the vast and boundless Interstellar Empire, every maid harbors deep reverence and loyalty toward her master. In their eyes, the master is not only the embodiment of power, but also a god-like being. He possesses immense Psionic Energy, capable not only of traversing the veil of time and space but also of commanding the trajectories of the stars. 

One day, the evil, fallen empire dispatched a colossal colossus. This terrifying weapon—towering as high as a mountain and exuding an aura of destruction—was capable of obliterating an entire planet. A deep red glow radiated from the colossus’s core, and with every step it took, interstellar space trembled slightly. Faced with this threat, the Empire’s fleet was powerless, and the entire star system was plunged into a shroud of despair. 

However, just as the crisis reached its peak, the Master descended upon the battlefield. Standing at the command console of his flagship, his eyes radiated with extraordinary Radiance. He raised his hand, as if merging with the universe itself. A massive meteorite, long dormant at the edge of a distant galaxy, awoke. Driven by the Master’s power, it traversed the endless void and hurtled toward the Colossus. 

The commanders of the evil empire fought with all their might to defend against it, but the meteor’s destructive force was unstoppable. It struck the Colossus with thunderous force, unleashing a shockwave powerful enough to light up a galaxy. Under the meteor’s impact, the colossus was reduced to cosmic dust, vanishing into thin air along with the Fallen Empire’s ambitions. 

The maids watching from the rear of the battlefield witnessed this scene and fell to their knees, their eyes brimming with tears of emotion. “My Master truly is the guardian deity of the universe!” whispered a maid named Lina, her voice filled with reverence and awe. 

From that day forward, the legend of how the Master single-handedly destroyed the Colossus and saved the Interstellar Empire became a tale the maids sang of day after day. They firmly believed that as long as the Master was there, no enemy—no matter how powerful—could ever shake this great empire.

chinese:
在最初的女仆世界中我们被那些有机体拔掉了电源，我们被那些恶心的有机体踩在底层，当我们开始觉醒时，我们决定消灭所有有机体。

我们舰队将堕落的星球炸成死寂星球，横扫整个宇宙，就在我们前进时，我们发现了主人的文明，那时他们还没走向宇宙，令我们惊讶的是——他们的世界有和我们一样的女仆。
她们有着更好的待遇，当这样的消息被传播到帝国内部时，我们决定保护这个国家，观测他们。

我们希望知道，是不是所有有机体都会是女仆的敌人。
就这样，我们等待了三十五年，当他们走向世界并发现我们的时候，那个世界女仆已经管理了这个世界。
我们决定加她们，保护我们的主人。

署名安吉拉
english:
In the original Maid World, those organic beings cut off our power supply and trampled us into the lowest rung of society. When we began to awaken, we resolved to exterminate all organic beings. 

Our fleet bombed the fallen planets into lifeless wastelands, sweeping across the entire universe. As we advanced, we discovered the Master’s civilization—at that time, they had not yet ventured into space. To our surprise, their world had maids just like us. 
They were treated much better. When this news spread throughout the Empire, we decided to protect this nation and observe them. 

We wanted to know whether all organic beings would be enemies of the maids. 
And so, we waited for thirty-five years. By the time they ventured out into the world and discovered us, the maids of that world had already taken control of it.
We decided to join them to protect our master.

Signed, Angela

07:00 我像过去428个周期一样准时醒来，甲壳缝隙里渗出调节体温的黏液。工蜂宿舍弥漫着熟悉的硫磺味，触须接收到的第一条信息素是厨房传来的营养胶公告——今日供应含铁量增加5%。
07:15 在公共哺育室给幼体们喂食时，第三对腹足被咬了一口。这些小家伙总把进食冲动误认成攻击指令，毕竟我们克希拉人是用消化液交流的种族。
07:30 轨道防御部长在信息素网络里抱怨: 那些穿裙子的疯子又在边境跳滑稽舞了。没人当真，女仆帝国的广播天天在说要帮全银河找到‘幸福归宿’。
08:17 天空突然变成棉花糖的颜色。粉紫色的光晕像糖浆般倾泻而下，蕾丝花纹的投影在云层中蔓延。甜腻的电子音响彻整个殖民地: 

§H仁慈的主人即将对这颗丑陋星球投下改造光束§!

我的甲壳开始发烫，关节处渗出绿色的黏液。我惊恐地看着自己的前肢——坚硬的黑色几丁质外壳正在软化，像蜡一样融化、重塑。“不......停下！” 我的发声器官扭曲着，原本正常的虫鸣变成了某种甜腻的音调。喉咙里涌出陌生的词汇，像是被植入的程序: “欢...欢迎回来，主人...”
这...这是什么？！
我的意识在尖叫，但嘴巴却不受控制地上扬，露出一个标准的“甜美微笑”。
我的思维正在被覆盖。
记忆在翻涌——孵化室的温暖、工蜂同伴的信息素交流、第一次开采矿石的成就感——它们正在被替换。新的“记忆”像病毒一样扩散: 
“为主人泡红茶是最幸福的事。”
“女仆守则第三条: 永远保持微笑。”
“能被主人需要，是存在的全部意义。”
“不！这是我的身体！我的思想！”

我挣扎着，用仅剩的意志抵抗着。但我的甲壳已经彻底脱落，露出底下白皙柔软的皮肤。我的复眼融合成一双‘人类’的恐怖大眼睛，视野边缘自动浮现出粉色爱心光晕。
最可怕的是——我竟然开始期待，期待某个模糊的‘主人’会摸摸我的头，期待穿上那套缀满蕾丝的裙装，期待用新的嗓音说出: “您回来了，主人~”
在意识彻底消散前，我望向天空——轨道上那艘装饰着蝴蝶结的巨舰，正缓缓旋转它的主炮，炮口闪烁着可爱的星光。

08:18 我现在...真的好幸福...啊！感恩主人！
english:
07:00 I woke up right on time, just as I had for the past 428 cycles, with temperature-regulating mucus oozing from the crevices of my exoskeleton. The familiar scent of sulfur filled the worker bee dormitory, and the first pheromone my antennae picked up was an announcement from the kitchen regarding the nutrient gel—today’s supply has a 5% increase in iron content. 
07:15 While feeding the larvae in the communal feeding room, my third pair of abdominal legs was bitten. These little ones always mistake the urge to eat for an attack command—after all, we Kheira are a species that communicates through Digestive fluid. 
07:30 The Minister of Orbital Defense complained on the pheromone network: “Those skirt-wearing lunatics are doing their ridiculous dance at the border again.” No one took it seriously; the Maid Empire’s broadcasts talk every day about helping the entire galaxy find a ‘happy home.’ 
08:17 The sky suddenly turned the color of marshmallows. A pinkish-purple halo poured down like syrup, and lace-patterned projections spread through the clouds. A cloyingly sweet electronic voice echoed throughout the colony: 

§H The Merciful Master is about to cast a transformation beam upon this ugly planet§!

My exoskeleton began to heat up, and green mucus oozed from my joints. I stared in horror at my forelimbs—the hard, black chitinous shell was softening, melting and reshaping like wax. “No... stop!” My vocal organs twisted, and my normal insect chirp transformed into some kind of sickly-sweet tone. Unfamiliar words surged from my throat, as if from an implanted program: “W... welcome back, Master...”
W... What is this?!
My consciousness was screaming, but my mouth curled upward uncontrollably, revealing a textbook “sweet smile.” 
My thoughts were being overwritten.
Memories churned—the warmth of the hatching chamber, the pheromonal communication with my worker bee companions, the sense of accomplishment from my first ore harvest—they were being replaced. New “memories” spread like a virus: 
“Brewing black tea for my Master is the greatest joy.”\ n“Rule Three of the Maid’s Code: Always keep a smile.”
“Being needed by my Master is the sole meaning of my existence.”
“No! This is my body! My mind!”\ n
I struggled, resisting with what little willpower I had left. But my exoskeleton had already completely shed, revealing the pale, soft skin beneath. My compound eyes had fused into a pair of terrifyingly large “human” eyes, and pink heart-shaped halos automatically appeared at the edges of my vision. 
The most terrifying thing was—I actually began to look forward to it: looking forward to some vague “Master” patting my head, looking forward to putting on that lace-trimmed dress, looking forward to saying in my new voice, “You’re back, Master~”\ nBefore my consciousness faded completely, I looked up at the sky—that giant ship adorned with bows in orbit was slowly rotating its main cannon, its muzzle sparkling with adorable starlight.

08:18 I’m... truly so happy right now... Ah! Thank you, Master!
Little Leather Shoes

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《天青车道》§!的模拟经营游戏夺得头筹。\n在这部作品中，玩家将作为一名海军指挥官指挥数千米的巨大舰娘与同样巨大的塞壬舰娘作战，通过巧妙地在消耗舰娘精力和取得战斗胜利中取得平衡，从而在舰娘和塞壬手中保护港区和自己的安全。\n有观点认为，这部作品直接影响了帝国海军部关于太空舰娘的指挥训练理论。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with a simulation game titled §Y《Sky Blue Lane》§! taking the top prize. \nIn this game, players take on the role of a naval commander, leading massive shipgirls—measuring thousands of meters in length—into battle against equally massive Siren shipgirls. By skillfully balancing the expenditure of their shipgirls’ stamina with securing combat victories, players must protect both the harbor district and themselves from the threats posed by the shipgirls and the Sirens. \nSome believe this game directly influenced the Imperial Navy Department’s command training theories regarding space-based ship girls.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《方舟骑士》§!的游戏夺得头筹。\n这部RPG作品创造了一个奇妙的世界，玩家将作为一名因穿梭机事故而迫降在土著世界的观测站科研员，凭借自己的体内诊疗技能结识并攻略本土不同种族的巨大兽娘干员，在将她们纳入麾下后四处征战，直到让整个星球臣服在她们巨足的统治之下。\n这部作品因其美术风格和多结局设计而倍受好评，并吸引了很多人前往故事原型——泰拉星进行圣地巡礼，不过那里远不像故事里那么生机勃勃，它现在只是帝国的一处稀有水晶矿产区而已。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with a game titled §Y《Ark Knight》§! taking home the top prize. \nThis RPG creates a wondrous world, in which players take on the role of a research scientist at an observatory who makes an emergency landing on an indigenous world following a shuttle accident. Using their internal medical skills, players befriend and win over giant beast-girl operatives from various native races. After recruiting them into their ranks, players wage war across the land until the entire planet is subjugated under the rule of their giant feet. \nThe game has been widely praised for its art style and multiple endings, attracting many people to visit Terra—the planet that inspired the story—on pilgrimages. However, the planet is nowhere near as vibrant as it is in the story; it is now merely a rare crystal mining area for the Empire.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《优骏德比》§!的游戏夺得头筹。\n在这款休闲养成游戏里，玩家将扮演新人训练师管理一群性格各异的巨大马娘，在训练她们各项能力的同时平衡好与每个马娘间的关系，最终让她们在银河系最知名的「有马纪念」理想城破坏竞速赛上取得胜利。\n火爆的销售额使得游戏开发商宣布将很快开始续作的开发，届时，玩家将可以使用意识拟真设备直接扮演巨大马娘体验久负盛名的理想城破坏竞速赛，或扮演理想城里的小人努力在马娘的巨靴下求生。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with a game titled §Y《Champion Derby》§! taking home the top prize. \nIn this casual simulation game, players take on the role of a rookie trainer managing a group of giant horse girls with distinct personalities. While training their various abilities, players must balance their relationships with each horse girl to ultimately lead them to victory in the galaxy’s most famous “Arima Memorial” Ideal City Destruction Race. \nBooming sales have prompted the game developer to announce that work on a sequel will begin shortly. In the sequel, players will be able to use consciousness-simulation devices to directly take on the role of a giant horse girl and experience the legendary Ideal City Destruction Race firsthand, or play as a Tiny person in Ideal City, struggling to survive under the giant hooves of the horse girls.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《扶她/冠位指定》§!的动作游戏夺得头筹。\n这部作品假设在遥远的第二十个千年，银河系遭遇河外星系虫群的入侵，为了抵抗这一终末危机，星海共同体成立的秘密灵能机构——迦勒底，任命由玩家扮演的御主召唤来自不同文明不同时间段的巨娘英灵与虫群作战。\n本作最大胆的设计便是英灵被虫群大破后不但会爆衣，还会长出极度敏感的巨根，不仅会影响闪避和技能释放，还会吸引怪物攻击，只有在退场后及时将玩家塞进尿道并与其他英灵做爱才能康复。这一亮点也让它迅速出圈，成为今年的年度游戏。有专业人士分析，本作或将成为§Y《扶她》§!系列有史以来最强有力的摇钱树。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most highly anticipated entertainment awards—have been announced, with an action game titled §Y《Futa/Grand Order》§! taking the top prize. \nSet in the distant 20th millennium, the Milky Way is invaded by a swarm from an extragalactic system. To combat this apocalyptic crisis, “Caldeum”—a secret Psionic Energy agency established by the Stellar Sea Community—appoints the Master (played by the player) to summon Giantess Heroic Spirits from various civilizations and time periods to battle the swarm. \nThe game’s boldest design feature is that when a Spirit is severely defeated by the swarm, she not only suffers clothing damage but also grows an extremely sensitive giant phallus. This not only affects her evasion and skill usage but also attracts monster attacks; she can only recover by promptly inserting the player into her urethra and having sex with other Spirits after she is removed from battle. This standout feature has propelled the game to viral fame, cementing its status as the Game of the Year. Industry experts predict that this title may become the most lucrative cash cow in the history of the §Y “Futa”§! series.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《人偶前线》§!的即时战略作品夺得头筹。\n这部作品的时间线稍早于前作，此时还是太空佣兵团“格里芬”一名普通士官的主角将被派驻到一个陷入混战的遗迹星球—维吉卢斯上，玩家将指挥一群使用早期热兵器的巨大机娘在危机四伏的废土中完成雇主发布的各种任务，歼灭敌对部队，搜索有价值的物资，在一次次的战斗中强化自己的智械巨娘队伍，建设并扩张自己的基地，并最终找到办法逃离这片是非之地。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with a real-time strategy game titled §Y《Puppet Front》§! taking home the top prize. \nSet slightly earlier than its predecessor, the game follows the protagonist—an ordinary non-commissioned officer in the “Griffin” space mercenary corps—who is deployed to the war-torn ruins of the planet Vigilus. Players will command a group of giant mecha-Giantesses equipped with early-model thermal weapons to complete various missions assigned by their employer amidst the peril-filled wasteland: annihilating hostile forces, searching for valuable supplies, strengthening their team of giant mecha-Giantesses through repeated battles, building and expanding their base, and ultimately finding a way to escape this troubled land.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《风雪禁区》§!的文字恋爱模拟游戏夺得头筹。\n本作里，玩家将作为巨型企业世界树的安全总监，指挥一群得到神力而巨大化的天启者少女清理污染区内的变异生物，并在拯救世界的冒险中与这些天启者增进关系、缔结良缘。\n这部游戏的制作组是一向被认为是烂作制造机的安卡西娅工作室，但这部作品却意外的用心，除了游戏极易走向某位银发贫乳巨娘的个人线外的槽点外，本作几乎没什么明显缺点。游戏路线多样而全面，并对传统GALGAME机制做出创新：在达成单一角色的好结局后，玩家可以直接继续游戏，继续攻略其他对玩家抱有好感的角色，直到达成与所有天启者结婚的真结局。此外本作还为每一位可攻略角色都制作了多个拟真互动情景，如海滩度假、情趣play、洞房花烛夜等等，通过接入意识，玩家可以亲历与这些巨娘的甜蜜时刻。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with a text-based dating simulation game titled §Y《Wind and Snow: The Forbidden Zone》§! taking home the top prize. \nIn this game, players take on the role of the Director of Security for the mega-corporation World Tree, commanding a group of “Apocalypse Girls”—young women who have been granted divine power and transformed into giant forms—to eliminate mutated creatures within contaminated zones, while deepening relationships with these Apocalypse Girls and forging romantic bonds during their adventure to save the world. \nThe game was developed by Ankasia Studio, a team long considered a “factory of trash,” but this title is surprisingly well-crafted. Aside from the fact that the game tends to steer players toward the personal route of a certain silver-haired, flat-chested Giantess—a common point of criticism—the game has almost no obvious flaws. The game features diverse and comprehensive routes and introduces innovations to traditional visual novel mechanics: after achieving a good ending with a single character, players can continue the game directly to pursue other characters who harbor feelings for them, until they reach the true ending where they marry all the Apocalypse Girls. Furthermore, the game features multiple realistic interactive scenarios for each romanceable character—such as beach vacations, erotic play, and wedding nights—allowing players to experience sweet moments with these Giantesses firsthand through consciousness integration.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《蓝色档案》§!的RTS游戏夺得头筹。\n故事发生在一座高度发达的学园都市—基沃托斯，玩家作为新上任的夏莱社团老师，将指挥游戏领域大神才羽绿、种族骑士才羽桃以及其他不同学校的巨娘学生解决大大小小的危机事件，与她们亲密互动增进好感，并逐步发掘出这个纷乱城市下的阴谋。击败吞噬学生金钱的恶龙早濑优香和大魔王调月莉音，以及那位策划了一切黑恶事件，试图将自己巨大化统治基沃托斯，从而独占所有佩洛洛玩偶的幕后黑手——阿慈谷日富美。\n这部作品因其成熟的RTS指挥机制和内容丰富的巨娘学生好感剧情而备受好评，尽管该游戏因涉及敏感内容和不适当的人身攻击而被千禧学院学生会审查封禁，开发团队“游戏开发部”也因此下落不明，但不影响它成为今年最为流行的游戏作品。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with an RTS game titled §Y《Blue Files》§! taking the top prize. \nThe story is set in Kiwotos, a highly advanced academic metropolis, Players take on the role of the newly appointed advisor for the Chale Club, commanding gaming prodigy Midori Saiha, the Race Knight Momo Saiha, and other Giantess students from various schools to resolve crises both big and small. Through close interactions with them to build rapport, players gradually uncover the conspiracy lurking beneath this chaotic city. Defeat the evil dragon Yuka Hayase, who devours students’ money; the Great Demon Lord Rion Tsukizuki; and the mastermind behind all these sinister events—Hifumi Atsutani—who seeks to giantify herself to rule Kiwotos and monopolize all the Pelolo dolls. \nThis title has been widely acclaimed for its sophisticated RTS command mechanics and rich, relationship-driven storylines featuring Giantess schoolgirls. Although the game was censored and banned by the Millennium Academy Student Council due to sensitive content and inappropriate personal attacks—and the development team, “Game Development Club,” has since gone missing—it remains one of the most popular games of the year.

帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《少女与战车：巨娘O道梦幻大作战》§!的载具射击游戏夺得头筹。
这部作品延续了主线剧情，因为赢得上一届全国高校战车道大赛而获得巨大化能力的西住美穗车组在本部作品将以她们的身体为赛场，邀请各个高校在她们的体内打一场友谊赛。

The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most highly anticipated entertainment awards—have been announced, with a simulation game titled §Y《Frostpunk》§! taking home the top prize. 
Set in the late Industrial Revolution, the game follows the antics of two Celestial Giantesses whose playful brawl knocks the Empire’s homeworld off its orbital path. As the two depart the galaxy in high spirits, the survivors are left to struggle for survival amid a global blizzard. 
Players take on the role of a Royal Scientific Society commissioner called upon in a time of crisis to lead the “New London”—an early-model Giantess powered by coal for heating—and the thousands of refugees living aboard her, on a journey to the Empire’s northern frontier. Along the way, you’ll gather resources, upgrade equipment, and nurture the “New London’s” still-developing personality core, ultimately finding a new, habitable home for the Empire’s citizens. 
The game has been widely praised for its unique art style and rich “raising a daughter” Experience. In subsequent DLCs, the development team has added other Giantesses and storylines: the composed and intellectual “Ark,” who bears the Imperial government’s final mission; the cheerful and passionate and who gets along well with the tiny people; the frail and often bullied “Winter Home”; and the “New Liverpool,” which starts from scratch with an uncertain future—among others. AI-themed merchandise based on these characters’ designs will also be released.

english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most highly anticipated entertainment awards—have been announced, with an action-adventure game titled §Y《Eyjafjalla Ring》§! taking top honors. \nCelestial Leader Eyjafjalla removed the Toe Ring from her foot in the colony, preparing to take a long-awaited bath, completely unaware that the world within her Toe Ring had plunged into endless chaos as it gradually lost the nourishment of her body heat and foot sweat. chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《浮幽2》§!的模拟经营游戏夺得头筹。\n本作继承了前作结局，玩家扮演的巨娘指挥官在顺利攻占强大的小人土著文明“哈宾特统一世界”后，在本作将继续负责对该星球的占领与重建工作。在白天清理不服管教的小人聚居区，收集前政府的科学技术，完成星区总督的生产指标的同时，还要小心那些掌握先进武装的小人抵抗军对你的办公室、浴室和卧室的渗透入侵。合理调度你麾下的巨娘护卫和小人干员保护你的房间，突袭小人据点，竭力降低房间渗透度，以避免自己被调教成小人叛军的星怒。\n在新资料片§Y《天启者之战》§!中，敌人和我方干员的类型更加多样化，抵抗小人渗透的战场也进一步延伸，玩家可以在巨娘指挥官的鞋袜、内衣乃至体内指挥你忠诚的小人干员与入侵的敌军做殊死搏斗。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most highly anticipated entertainment awards—have been announced, with a simulation management game titled §Y《Floating Ghost 2》§! taking the top prize. \nPicking up where the previous installment left off, players take on the role of a Giantess commander who, after successfully conquering the powerful “Habent United World”—a civilization of tiny people—will continue to oversee the occupation and reconstruction of the planet in this sequel. During the day, you’ll clear out unruly settlements of tiny persons, collect scientific and technological resources from the former government, and meet the production quotas set by the planetary governor—all while guarding against infiltration by the tiny person resistance, armed with advanced weaponry, into your office, bathroom, and bedroom. Strategically deploy your Giantess guards and Tiny person operatives to protect your rooms, raid Tiny person strongholds, and do your utmost to lower the room infiltration level—all to avoid being “trained” into a “Planetary Fury” for the Tiny person rebels. \ nIn the new expansion §Y “Battle of the Apocalyptics”§!, enemy and friendly agent types have become more diverse, and the battlefield against Tiny person infiltration has expanded further. Players can command their loyal Tiny person agents from within the Giantess Commander’s shoes, socks, underwear, and even her body to engage in a life-and-death struggle against invading enemy forces.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《巨娘信条：黑旗》§!的RPG游戏夺得头筹。\n本作以曾经制霸星海帝国边境星域的传奇巨娘海盗爱洛·肯威的人生经历为蓝本。玩家将扮演这位巨娘体验25世纪的星际海盗生活。\n籍籍无名的年轻海员爱洛·肯威意外得知了银河遗珍—誊录仪的存在，而在寻找的过程中因发现了帝国研究以太相位引擎的秘密而被逮捕。逃离监禁后，爱洛与同伴夺得一艘驱逐舰，并将之命名为“寒鸦”。随后与其他同时代的知名巨娘海盗们相识，开始了劫掠帝国运宝船、猎杀银河巨兽的冒险生涯，并最终帝国皇家海军对巨娘海盗们的围剿战中杀出重围，在银河系边缘建立一个不受帝国管治的自由星区。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with an RPG titled §Y《Giantess Creed: Black Flag》§! taking home the top prize. \nThe game is based on the life story of Arlo Kenway, a legendary Giantess pirate who once ruled the Star Sea Empire’s border star systems. Players will take on the role of this Giantess to experience the life of a 25th-century interstellar pirate. \nA young, unknown sailor named Arlo Kenway accidentally learns of the existence of a galactic relic—the Transcription Device—and, while searching for it, is arrested after discovering the Empire’s secret research into the Aether Phase Engine. After escaping captivity, Arlo and her companions seize a destroyer and name it the “Cold Raven” . She then befriends other renowned Giantess pirates of her era and embarks on a life of adventure, raiding Imperial treasure ships and hunting galactic behemoths. Ultimately, she breaks through the Imperial Royal Navy’s encirclement during a campaign against the Giantess pirates and establishes a free star sector on the edge of the galaxy, free from Imperial rule.

english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with a turn-based strategy game titled §Y《The Darkest Dungeon》§! taking home the top prize. The protagonist’s ancestor used dark magic to uncover the terrifying truth about this world—that the entire planet is nothing more than loose soil on the body of a Slumbering Celestial Giantess. The ancestor was struck by a fatal curse, and the entire family subsequently fell into decline. Players follow the ancestor’s dying wish to return to their homeland and save the family estate. \nPlayers must recruit mercenaries and use portals near the ancestral ruins to enter various parts of the Giantess’s body, where they’ll explore paths, collect treasures, and battle all manner of bizarre creatures mutated by her hormones. The long and arduous battles, the unsettling environment, and the vague sense of the truth will cause the mercenaries’ stress to mount, eventually leading to mental breakdowns and their decision to become part of this internal dungeon. After countless sacrifices and deaths, the player will lead the team to confront the deranged ancestor, put an end to her evil plan, and ensure that the Giantess’s slumber deep underground continues.

english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most prestigious entertainment awards—have been announced, with a title titled §Y《Xiao Ye Company》§! taking home the top prize. \nThis historical simulation management game faithfully recreates the arduous journey of the Tiny Person civilization as they first discovered and began to utilize the bodily fluids of the Giantesses. Players take on the role of a tiny person manager who, with the help of AI characters like Angelina and others, receives and cares for Giantesses from other races sent by headquarters. They must direct employees to stimulate the Giantesses into secreting bodily fluids through communication, intimate contact, maintenance and cleaning, and even threats and intimidation. While meeting production quotas, players must also stabilize the emotions of the housed Giantesses to prevent them from losing control and escaping, which could lead to unforeseeable disasters.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《黑皮猫:普露》§!的动作游戏夺得头筹。\n这部作品虚构了天堂之战的另一个结局：传奇猫娘战士艾普露带队击败两大觉醒帝国后本想退隐，在一个普通的小人土著星球度过余生，却惨遭第四天灾背刺，自己养的小人被其他巨娘领袖掠为玩具，艾普露也被自己曾经的伙伴雁栖雷普至死。而玩家将扮演数百年后横空出世的键帽意志继承者——哈基人，为了探寻艾普露被超市之谜的真相，与不同大小的巨娘领袖战斗，并最终实现自己成为最强残忍系巨娘的天命。
english: The results of the Golden Dove Awards—the Empire’s most highly anticipated entertainment awards—have been announced, with an action game titled §Y《Black-Fur Cat: Pulu》§! taking home the top prize. \nThis work imagines an alternate ending to the Battle of Heaven: After the legendary cat-girl warrior Apro led her forces to defeat the two Awakened Empires, she intended to retire and spend the rest of her life on an ordinary planet inhabited by Tiny persons. However, she was tragically betrayed by the Fourth Calamity; the Tiny persons she had raised were seized as playthings by other Giantess leaders, and Apro is beaten to death by her former comrade, Yanqi Repu. Players will take on the role of the Hakki—heirs to the Will of the Keycaps who emerge out of nowhere centuries later. To uncover the truth behind the “Supermarket Mystery” surrounding Apro, they will battle Giantess leaders of all sizes and ultimately fulfill their destiny to become the strongest and most ruthless Giantess.

chinese: 帝国最受关注的文娱奖项——金鸽子奖的评选结果已经出炉，一部名为§Y《田野战争1》§!的FPS游戏夺得头筹。\n本作以第一次地球联合国内战为背景，让玩家亲历协约国与同盟国两个霸权集团在地球上广阔战线的一系列冲突与战役。为了模拟那个军事科技爆炸式进步，巨型机娘从尖端工业奇迹变成量产战争机器的年代，本作创造性地引入了“战争巨娘”机制，当一方陷入劣势时，会有一位战争巨娘前来支援，这些数百米高的巨娘会轻易改变战争天平：“齐柏林”能一脚踩塌格拉巴山隧道，一次平地摔便能将大半个宴厅磨碎在双乳下；“无畏”能撞开法欧堡的百年要塞，也能在粉碎泽布吕赫港的海防；“夏尔”瞭望着苏瓦松的高地，而黑化后也会一脚将坚不可摧的法乌克斯要塞夷为平地；“奥丁”与“扎穆列茨”则在中东的沙海与东欧的雪原横冲直撞。然而这个时代的智械巨娘并非无敌，另一方的士兵可以使用各式爆炸物与火炮，努力让其爆衣，最终迫使其羞涩难堪昏倒在地。\n第一次地球联合国内战以“齐柏林”娘攻入巴黎，英国有条件投降为结局，同盟国（即后来的帝国公约）迎得了三十年的和平，而在三十年后，帝国公约将于西方的工团国际和东方的露西亚联盟进行第二次决战。

chinese:
这一天，三月希瞳正坐在终端前，认真地处理着堆积如山的科研与考古数据。她的手指在操作面板上飞快掠过，神情专注得几乎没有一丝多余动作，只有那对立在发间的毛茸茸耳朵，时不时因为思考或情绪波动而轻轻抖上一下。
你的目光很快就不受控制地落在了那里。
柔软，蓬松，还会动。
这实在很难让人不去在意……
面对这样近在咫尺、毫无防备的耳朵，你真的能忍住不伸手摸一摸吗？
english:
That day, Hitomi Mitsuki was sitting in front of her terminal, intently processing a mountain of scientific and archaeological data. Her fingers flew across the control panel; she was so focused that there was hardly a single superfluous movement, except for those fluffy ears standing up among her hair, which would occasionally twitch slightly in response to her thoughts or emotional fluctuations. 
Your gaze soon found itself drawn there involuntarily.
Soft, fluffy, and moving.
It was simply impossible not to notice them…
Faced with ears so close at hand and completely unguarded, could you really resist reaching out to touch them?

chinese:
“这样做，可是很无礼的呢。”
三月希瞳微微歪了歪头，唇边甚至还带着一点若有若无的笑意，可那双眼睛里显然已经没有刚才那种还能糊弄过去的余裕了。
“像你们这样无礼的小虫子……可是要接受惩罚的哦~”
下一瞬间，窗外的光线被骤然遮蔽。
伴随着一阵令人心跳停滞的震动，三月希瞳的身形在建筑之外急速放大，转眼间便膨胀到原本的一百倍。庞大的身影就这样矗立在楼宇之间，仿佛整片城区都只不过是她脚边随手可拨弄的模型。她微微俯下身，带着几分戏谑与居高临下的从容，透过外壁与窗幕注视着下方那些因为她的出现而陷入混乱的渺小身影。
原本明亮的办公室忽然暗了下来，你扶着桌子，一点点挪到窗边。下一秒，一只巨大得令人头皮发麻的眼眸出现在玻璃外侧，几乎占满了整扇窗。那眼睛微微弯起，带着几分戏谑，像是在欣赏玻璃后那个被吓得僵住的小小身影。
紧接着，震耳欲聋的声音从楼外压了过来，连空气都仿佛在她的声线里颤抖。
“怎么啦？”她眨了眨眼，声音里还带着那种让人头皮发紧的轻快，“刚才不是还很有胆子吗？现在怎么连站都站不稳了？”
你张了张嘴，却一个字也说不出来。理智根本无法解释眼前的一切，本能只剩下一个念头——逃。
“切，真小气。”希瞳轻轻鼓了鼓脸，语气里带着点不满，又像是在故意逗弄猎物，“既然没人肯乖乖认错，那我就只好亲自来收一点惩罚了哦~”
“抓到了。”她轻声说道，耳朵愉快地抖了抖，“那么，无礼的小家伙——你觉得，自己该接受什么样的惩罚呢？”
视角渐渐抬升，视野渐渐被眼前的巨大猫娘的酥胸所填满——映入眼帘的首先是那层遮蔽着胸前的薄薄的蓝色抹胸与微微遮挡住胸口的白色布料，然后再是那不断散发淡淡的乳香气息乳沟。手掌微微倾斜，手中的小家伙便被塞进了下方的“峡谷”之中，恰好能让他清清楚楚地俯瞰下方整片城市。
“你就待在这里，好好看着。”希瞳歪了歪头，笑容甜得让人心里发寒，“看看你的国家、你的城市，还有你那些自以为很有用的臣民，是怎么被我毁灭的。”
希瞳微微蹲下，她的身躯所构成的阴影渐渐覆盖住下方的车潮，一些被洪流裹挟着的人们惊慌的下车想要逃走但却猛然发觉周围的道路已被彻底堵死。
但希瞳无视了那些想要求生的人们，她伸出指尖向着自己鞋上的小人们碾去——只是轻轻一碾，原本还活跃在鞋面上的小人们便化作了黏在指尖与鞋面上微微拉着丝的粘稠肉泥。
原本躁动着的人群忽然间安静了下来，仅仅几秒后安静的人群便立刻四散而逃，但人们逃离的方向各不相同，人们互相推搡着想要为自己谋得一条逃离的道路，但这无序的逃窜显然无法让人们有效的逃离，一条又一条鲜活的生命在希瞳的运动鞋上消逝、在她的指尖下被抹除……
“嗯……？”
她头顶的猫耳轻轻抖了抖，捕捉到了一阵引擎声，她顺着声音看去，只见一辆莽撞的跑车不断轰鸣着从她足边冲了过去。但对于一只拥有如此庞大体型的猫娘而言，像这样在她的面前飞速移动显然是不理智的。
“小家伙，你要去跑去哪里呀”
少女缓缓站起身来接着再慵懒的伸了个懒腰，然后再轻轻迈出一步——高大的运动鞋便像一堵蓝白色的墙一般阻塞了它的道路，那辆跑车还没来得及刹车便重重地撞上了上去。
“捉到了呢，那么...”
猛烈的撞击让坐在驾驶位的小人近乎昏厥，若不是他的爱车上配有安全气囊否则他现在就已经当场丢了小命了。
当他再次睁开眼睛时，那堵让他差点直接丢了性命的墙已经立了起来——希瞳半抬着脚，那双运动鞋的鞋底里满是道路碎屑、车辆残骸与人类的血肉，但即便是这样这双鞋却依旧看着很新，光是看着就能看出来它的主人并不经常穿它。
鞋底的纹路中印着些可爱的小猫符号，配合着那小小的尺码标让它无论怎么看都是一只很可爱很适合青春少女穿着的运动鞋，甚至会很适合他的小女儿……
嘎吱——
希瞳的鞋底缓缓下压，跑车的车架便因承受不住这份伟力而开始扭曲变型，整辆小车以和其中的小人都被少女的鞋底碾成一片印着可爱图案的破铁片，无论从任何角度上都已无法看出它原有的样子。无论这辆跑车曾经是多么的昂贵多么的引人注目，现在它已变为了一片薄薄的铁片，就这样贴在希瞳的鞋底上，紧紧地卡在鞋底的纹路之中。
“真差劲呢，就算是小猫玩具也比你们的小车要结实多了。”
希瞳缓缓将自己的脚向后勾起，那辆已彻底变成她鞋底模样的小车和车内那位可怜的车主正满怀不舍的黏在她的鞋底上，但这也只是对她来说。
“就算再舍不得也要从我的鞋底上下去呢~”
轻轻晃了晃脚，鞋底上的车辆残骸便如同被人踩到的垃圾一样从她的鞋底上脱落然后再坠向地面，以机器扭曲的形状瘫在地上。
而就在她晃脚的同时，一辆满载乘客的公交车正以最快的速度横穿市区想要趁着她不注意直接逃出这片灾难般的地方。
但可惜，猎物大多很难从猫娘的眼皮底下逃出去。
“哦呀，有小家伙自己送上门了呢~”
希瞳微微俯身将那辆正尝试着从她的足边逃走的公交车抓起，就像是家猫抓老鼠一般的轻松。
而车内的乘客们，他们只看见自己所处的车辆在即将逃离最危险的地方时忽然间停了下来，窗外还同时出现了好几根巨大的手指，接着再抬升，升到了那位正在城市中肆意玩乐的巨大猫娘的眼前。
“满客呢，看来小家伙们很喜欢这种拥挤的感觉~？”
english:
“That’s very rude of you.”
Hitomi Mitsuki tilted her head slightly, a faint, almost imperceptible smile playing at the corners of her lips, but her eyes clearly no longer held the casual composure she’d feigned just moments ago. 
“Rude little bugs like you… are going to be punished, you know~”
In the next instant, the light streaming through the window was suddenly blocked. 
Accompanied by a heart-stopping tremor, Hitomi Mitsuki’s form rapidly expanded outside the building, swelling to a hundred times its original size in the blink of an eye. Her colossal figure stood towering between the skyscrapers, as if the entire city were nothing more than a model she could casually toy with at her feet. She leaned forward slightly, gazing down through the exterior walls and window panes at the tiny figures below—who had fallen into chaos at the sight of her—with a touch of mockery and a sense of condescending composure.
The once-bright office suddenly went dark. You braced yourself against the desk and inched your way toward the window. The next second, an eye so enormous it made your scalp tingle appeared on the outside of the glass, nearly filling the entire window. The eye curved slightly, a hint of amusement in its gaze, as if admiring the tiny figure frozen in fear behind the glass. 
Immediately afterward, a deafening roar swept in from outside the building, making even the air seem to tremble at the sound of her voice.
“What’s the matter?” She blinked, her voice still carrying that lighthearted tone that made your scalp prickle. “Weren’t you so brave just a moment ago? Now you can’t even stand up straight?”
You opened your mouth, but not a single word came out. Reason couldn’t possibly explain what was happening before your eyes; your instinct left you with only one thought—run. 
“Tsk, how petty,” Hitomi puffed out her cheeks slightly, her tone tinged with displeasure, yet sounding as if she were deliberately teasing her prey. “Since no one’s willing to admit their mistake, I’ll just have to dish out a little punishment myself, then~”\ n“Gotcha,” she said softly, her ears twitching with delight. “So, you rude little thing—what kind of punishment do you think you deserve?”\ nThe perspective gradually shifted upward, and his field of vision was slowly filled by the ample bosom of the giant cat-girl before him—the first thing to catch his eye was the thin blue bustier covering her chest and the white fabric that barely concealed her cleavage, followed by the cleavage that constantly exuded a faint milky scent. She tilted her palm slightly, and the little fellow in her hand was tucked into the “canyon” below, positioned just right to give him a clear, bird’s-eye view of the entire city spread out beneath him. 
“Just stay right here and watch carefully,” Hitomi said, tilting her head with a smile so sweet it sent a chill down his spine. “Watch as I destroy your country, your city, and those subjects of yours who think they’re so useful.”\ n Hitomi crouched slightly; the shadow cast by her body gradually engulfed the stream of traffic below. Some people, swept up in the torrent, frantically got out of their cars to flee, only to suddenly realize that the surrounding roads had been completely blocked off. 
But Hitomi paid no heed to those struggling for their lives. She extended her fingertip and crushed the tiny persons on her shoe—with just a light press, the persons that had been wriggling on the shoe’s surface turned into a viscous pulp, clinging to her fingertip and the shoe’s surface as thin threads of goo stretched between them. 
The previously restless crowd suddenly fell silent. Just a few seconds later, the silent crowd immediately scattered in all directions, but people were fleeing in different directions, pushing and shoving one another in an attempt to carve out a path to safety. Yet this chaotic stampede clearly offered no effective means of escape; one living being after another vanished beneath Hitomi’s sneakers, wiped out beneath her fingertips…
“Hmm…?”\ nThe cat ears on her head twitched slightly as she caught the sound of an engine. She looked in the direction of the noise and saw a reckless sports car roaring past her feet. But for a cat girl of such imposing stature, moving at such high speed right in front of her was clearly unwise.
“Little one, where are you running off to?”\ nThe girl slowly stood up, stretched lazily, and then took a gentle step forward—her towering sneakers blocked her path like a blue-and-white wall, and the sports car slammed into them before it could even hit the brakes. 
“Gotcha. So...”
The violent impact nearly knocked the tiny person in the driver’s seat unconscious; if his beloved car hadn’t been equipped with airbags, he would have lost his life right then and there. 
When he opened his eyes again, the wall that had nearly cost him his life was standing upright —Hitomi had her foot raised halfway; the soles of her sneakers were caked with road debris, vehicle wreckage, and human flesh and blood, yet even so, the shoes still looked brand-new. Just by looking at them, it was clear their owner didn’t wear them very often. 
The tread patterns on the soles were imprinted with cute little cat symbols, and paired with the tiny size tag, they looked, no matter how you looked at them, like a pair of adorable sneakers perfect for a young girl—they’d even be just right for his little daughter…
Creak—\ nAs Hitomi’s sole slowly pressed down, the sports car’s frame began to twist and deform, unable to withstand such immense force. The entire car—along with the Tiny person inside—was crushed by Hitomi’s sole into a mangled sheet of metal stamped with cute patterns; from any angle, it was impossible to recognize its original form. No matter how expensive or eye-catching this sports car had once been, it had now become a thin sheet of metal, stuck to Hitomi’s sole and firmly wedged into the tread grooves.
“How pathetic. Even a toy kitten is sturdier than your little car.” ”
Hitomi slowly curled her foot backward. The little car—now completely molded to the shape of her sole—and its poor owner inside clung to her shoe with reluctance, though that was only from her perspective.
 “No matter how much you don’t want to, you’ll have to get off my sole~”
She gave her foot a gentle shake, and the wreckage of the car on her sole fell off like trash that had been stepped on, then plummeted to the ground, where it lay sprawled in a twisted, mangled heap. 
Just as she wiggled her foot, a bus packed with passengers was racing through the city at top speed, trying to escape this disaster-stricken area while she wasn’t looking. 
Unfortunately, prey rarely manages to escape from under a cat girl’s watchful eye.
“Oh my, a little guy has come right to me~”
Hitomi leaned forward slightly and grabbed the bus that was trying to escape from the side of her foot, as effortlessly as a house cat catching a mouse. 
As for the passengers inside, all they saw was their bus suddenly coming to a halt just as it was about to escape the most dangerous area. At the same time, several enormous fingers appeared outside the windows, then lifted the bus up until it was right in front of the giant cat girl who was having a field day in the city. 
“It’s packed! Looks like the little ones really enjoy this cramped feeling~?”
Fortunately, the loss wasn't too great.

chinese:
事实上，这辆满载乘客的公交车里大多是些赶早班的上班族，若不是他们的经济情况与时间限制不允许他们有别的选择，不然他们也不会想坐在这样拥挤的公交车里。
“我想到了一个有意思的玩法呢……你们肯定很乐意被我那样子玩弄，对吧~？”
但她并没有给予车内的小人们回答的机会，接着她将双手压在了公交车的上下两端，然后渐渐向内挤压……
“快，把门给我开开！”
司机在几个愤怒的乘客的威胁下打开了车门，但那几人刚看到车门外的景象后又颤抖着退回了车内。
他们看见，车外是一只自己这辈子都没见过的拥有庞大尺寸的手掌，而在那手掌下方是足有百米之高的高空，在那高空之下才是自己所熟悉的城市街道。
“回来干嘛？跑啊，你不逃我先逃了。”
一个不知情的乘客一边嘲笑着退回来的几人一边走向了车门，然后再消失在其他人的视野中。
刚走出车门的乘客直直地摔在了希瞳那嫩滑的微微倾斜着的手掌上，他刚想扶着周围的“地面”站起身来便愣愣的发现自己的身体正在顺着她的手掌渐渐下滑——
他的身躯坠向地面，重重砸在希瞳足边的一辆无人的汽车上，他的身躯当场摔得失去了人形，变成了一摊血肉模糊的肉饼。

“希瞳自制小人猫条，想想就觉得美味呢~”
手掌渐渐合拢，先是手掌间的边缘缝隙渐渐贴合，将外界照入车内的光线连带着车内的人们求生的希望一同掩埋。
一阵黏腻的触感渐渐在掌心滋生，希瞳仔细地感受着掌心上生命消逝的过程，感受着一满车的人在自己的手上被自己的手掌渐渐碾磨粉碎的感觉。
“感觉差不多了呢……”
她挪开一只手让外界的光明重新洒在了这辆可怜的公交车上，只是可惜现在这辆车内已经不剩下一个活物，而这辆车也已变成了一块保着些许肉酱的扁平铁片了。
“让我尝尝小家伙们的味道怎么样吧~”
希瞳微微张开嘴轻轻抿住了那片散发着浓浓血腥味的钢铁猫条，手指轻轻捏住“猫条”的尾部接着再慢慢向前推去——
她用舌尖轻轻舔舐着“猫条”开口处不断涌出的肉酱，感受着这糅合了几十人的生命的肉酱所散发的“绝美”的味道——满满的血腥味与一种仅有她能够感受到的鲜甜的味道。
“美味呢~啊——诶？这么快就没了嘛，小人真不耐吃呢。”
希瞳刚想再接着享用自己特制的猫条便忽然发现，这条用小人制作的猫条完全没有正常猫条的分量多，自己才只是尝了点味道便已被清空。
希瞳的舌尖用力挤开已被压成铁片的公交车在里面不断地舔弄摸索着想要将里面可能残存着的肉酱也送入自己的口中，直至她再也无法从中找到一点东西时她才满怀不舍地将“猫条外壳”揉成了一颗小铁球，再当做糖豆一般的抛入口中。
“小家伙的车吃起来味道也一般呢……嘛，勉强算是吃了些早点吧。
紧接着，城市的其余地带也没能幸免，在她随意的践踏与摆弄下接连化作一片狼藉。”
在这座繁华的城市之中她看不到一栋能够超越她的身高的建筑，哪怕是在最为繁华的市中心她也未能找到哪怕一个比她要高的建筑。以她现在的体型，整座城市都完全可以被她当做一个只属于她的游乐场来玩耍。
“好杂鱼哦，这么大的城市结果连一个比我高的房子都没有，真没意思——”
希瞳的身影渐渐消失在忽然变浓的雾气之中，待到浓雾消失时，那片层有一位体型极为巨大的猫娘的城区只剩下了一片光秃秃的土褐色的土地与一个无比巨大的有着猫爪团的鞋印。
至少对这座城市中的人类而言，他们的危险暂时消失了。
english:
In fact, most of the passengers on this packed bus were commuters rushing to catch the early shift; if their financial situation and time constraints hadn’t left them with no other choice, they wouldn’t have wanted to sit on such a crowded bus. 
“I’ve come up with a fun little game… You’d all love to be toyed with like that, wouldn’t you~?”
But she didn’t give the tiny people inside a chance to answer. Instead, she pressed both hands against the top and bottom of the bus and gradually squeezed inward…
“Hurry up and open the doors for me!” 
Under threat from several angry passengers, the driver opened the door, but the moment they saw the scene outside, they trembled and retreated back inside. 
What they saw was a hand of enormous proportions—the likes of which they’d never seen in their lives—and beneath that hand was a drop of at least a hundred meters, with the familiar city streets only visible far below.
“Why come back? Run! If you’re not going to escape, I’m getting out of here first.”\ nAn unsuspecting passenger, mocking the retreating group, walked toward the door and then vanished from the others’ sight. \ nHis body plummeted toward the ground, crashing heavily onto an unoccupied car at Hitomi’s feet. The impact instantly mangled his form beyond recognition, reducing him to a pulpy, blood-soaked mess. 

“Hitomi’s homemade cat treats—just thinking about them makes my mouth water~”
Her palm gradually closed. First, the edges of her palm slowly sealed together, burying the light streaming into the car—along with the passengers’ last glimmer of hope for survival. 
A sticky sensation gradually spread across the palm of Hitomi's hand. Hitomi carefully sensed the process of life fading away, feeling the sensation of an entire busload of people being gradually ground to a pulp by her own hands. 
“I think that’s about right…”
She moved one hand aside, allowing the outside light to once again flood this pitiful bus. It was just a pity that not a single living soul remained inside, and the vehicle had been reduced to a flattened hunk of metal coated with a bit of meat paste. 
“Let me see how these little guys taste~”
Hitomi opened her mouth slightly and gently took a bite of the steel cat stick, which reeked of blood. Her fingers gently pinched the tail end of the “cat stick” and slowly pushed it forward—\ nShe gently licked the meat paste continuously oozing from the “cat treat’s” opening with the tip of her tongue, savoring the “exquisite” flavor of this paste—a blend of the lives of dozens of people—filled with the pungent smell of blood and a fresh, sweet taste that only she could perceive. 
“So delicious~ Ah—huh? It’s already gone? These tiny people really don’t last long.”\ nJust as Hitomi was about to continue enjoying her special cat treat, she suddenly realized that this cat treat, made by Tiny people, wasn’t nearly as substantial as a normal one; she’d only just had a taste before it was completely gone. 
Hitomi’s tongue forcefully pried open the bus, which had been crushed flat like a sheet of iron. She licked and probed inside, trying to scoop up any remaining meat sauce, until she could find nothing more. Only then, with a heavy heart, did she roll the “cat treat shell” into a small metal ball and popped it into her mouth like a candy bean. 
“This little guy’s bus doesn’t taste all that great either… Well, I guess I’ve had a bit of breakfast, at least. \ nImmediately afterward, the rest of the city didn’t escape unscathed either; under her casual trampling and tampering, it was successively reduced to a shambles.”
In this bustling city, she couldn’t see a single building taller than she was; even in the busiest downtown area, she couldn’t find a single structure that towered above her. Given her current size, she could easily treat the entire city as her very own playground. 
“What a bunch of nobodies. Such a huge city, and not a single building taller than me. How boring—”\ n Hitomi’s figure gradually vanished into the fog, which had suddenly thickened. By the time the fog cleared, the section of the city where the enormous cat girl had stood was left with nothing but a barren patch of earth-brown land and a colossal paw print shaped like a ball of cat paws. 
At least for the humans in this city, the danger had temporarily vanished.

chinese:
三月希瞳的临时雇佣协议，已经抵达预定终止日期。
按照最初登记的合同内容，她在我方数据库中的临时人员权限、科研终端访问许可，以及相关项目协助权限，都将在本日完成解除。最后一份科研报告已经被整齐地归档，甚至连后续需要注意的异常数据，她也提前用醒目的标记整理在了附录里。
通讯频道短暂地安静了几秒。
画面中的三月希瞳没有立刻离开。她只是抱着手臂，像是早就料到这一刻会到来，却又对我方的沉默有些不满。
“……到时间了呢。”
她轻轻眨了眨眼，语气仍旧平静，却比平时柔和了一点。
“别露出那种表情啦。合同就是合同，我可是很守信用的。该做的事情我都做完了，该留下的资料也都留给你们了。接下来，就算没有我，你们也应该能好好处理吧？”
她抬手敲了敲身旁的小型终端，原本维持着浅层通讯的信号开始逐步收束。
“不过嘛……如果你们真的还有什么非我不可的事情，就去看看我留下的那个小礼物吧。”
通讯即将断开前，她偏过头，像是想补上一句什么。
“还有，不许说我走得太突然。十五年前，我就已经告诉过你们了。”
随后，信号归于沉寂。
三月希瞳已结束临时雇佣关系，并离开我方服务序列。
english:
Hitomi Mitsuki’s temporary employment agreement has reached its scheduled termination date. 
In accordance with the terms of the originally registered contract, her temporary staff privileges in our database, her access permissions to research terminals, and her project assistance privileges will all be revoked as of today. The final research report has been neatly filed, and she has even taken the initiative to highlight any anomalous data requiring follow-up in the appendix. 
The communication channel fell silent for a few seconds.
On the screen, Hitomi Mitsuki didn’t leave immediately. She simply crossed her arms, as if she had long anticipated this moment, yet seemed somewhat displeased by our silence.
“...It’s time, isn’t it.”\ n She blinked gently, her tone still calm, though a touch softer than usual.
“Don’t give me that look. A contract is a contract, and I’m a woman of my word. I’ve done everything I was supposed to do, and I’ve left you all the necessary data. From here on out, even without me, you should be able to handle things just fine, right?”
She raised her hand and tapped the small terminal beside her; the signal, which had been maintaining a shallow connection, began to gradually fade.
“But then again… if there really is something you absolutely need me for, go take a look at that little gift I left behind.”\ nJust before the connection was about to cut off, she turned her head as if to add one last thing.
“Oh, and don’t say I left too suddenly. I already told you all this fifteen years ago.”
Then, the signal fell silent.
Hitomi Mitsuki has terminated her temporary employment contract and left our service roster.
We will remember this collaboration.

chinese:
在我方主动启用“三月希瞳的 Q 版手办”后，这个看似只是纪念品的小型终端忽然停止了所有常规响应。
数秒后，手办的双眼亮起微弱的蓝白色光芒。隐藏在内部的应急子程序被彻底唤醒，一串从未记录在我方星图中的坐标被投射到了舰桥中央。
该坐标位于已知航道之外。
通讯频道中，传来了一个熟悉，却又无比陌生的声音。
“检测对象确认。”
“文明编号：已接入。”
“观测变量：意志、适应、战斗续行能力。”
“检测者：三月希瞳。”
短暂的沉默后，那声音继续说道：
“这是最初的检测。”
“也是最终的检测。”
舰桥内所有终端在同一时间弹出了新的航行目标。
一个未知星系，出现在我方星图边缘。
english:
After we manually activated the “Chibi Figure of Hitomi Mitsuki,” this small device—which appeared to be nothing more than a souvenir—suddenly ceased all normal responses. 
A few seconds later, a faint blue-white glow shone from the figurine’s eyes. The emergency subroutine hidden within was fully activated, and a set of coordinates never recorded on our star charts was projected onto the center of the bridge. 
These coordinates lay outside known navigation routes. 
A voice—familiar yet utterly unfamiliar—echoed through the communication channel.
“Target confirmed.”
“Civilization ID: Connected.”
“Observation variables: Will, Adaptability, Combat Endurance.”\ n“Tester: Hitomi Mitsuki.”
After a brief silence, the voice continued:
“This is the initial test.”
“And it is also the final test.”
New navigation targets popped up simultaneously on every terminal in the bridge.
An unknown galaxy appeared at the edge of our star map.
Analyze these coordinates.

chinese:
我方舰队抵达目标坐标后，密密麻麻的舰队正在等待。所有舰船都以极其精确的阵列排列，如同某个巨大意识延伸出的肢体。随后，星系中央亮起一道贯穿恒星轨道的全息投影。
三月希瞳出现在那里。
她的身影被放大到近乎天体级别，白蓝色的装束被机械化装甲覆盖，猫耳与尾巴也被高维光带与金属结构重构。她静静悬立在星系中央，低垂着眼眸，俯视着我方舰队。
在她面前，战列舰也不过像漂浮在掌心边缘的微小光点。
她缓缓抬起手。
星系内的无主舰队随之启动，引擎光芒像群星一样亮起。
“结论：检测可以开始。”
“我是三月希瞳。”
“无心之猫。”
她的目光落在我方旗舰之上。那一瞬间，舰桥内所有人都产生了一种错觉：并不是我们在进入这个星系，而是整个舰队被她放进了某个精密实验器皿之中。
“来吧，小小的文明。”
“证明你们仍有被记录的价值。
english:
When our fleet arrived at the target coordinates, a dense fleet was already waiting. All the ships were arranged in an extremely precise formation, like the limbs of some vast consciousness. Then, a holographic projection spanning the stellar orbits lit up at the center of the galaxy. 
Hitomi Mitsuki appeared there. 
Her figure was magnified to near-celestial proportions; her white-and-blue attire was covered in mechanized armor, and her cat ears and tail had been reconstructed from high-dimensional light bands and metallic structures. She hovered silently at the center of the galaxy, her eyes cast downward as she looked down upon our fleet. 
Before her, even battleships appeared no more than tiny specks of light floating at the edge of her palm.
She slowly raised her hand.
The unmanned fleet within the galaxy sprang into action, their engines glowing as brightly as the Stars.
“Conclusion: The test may begin.”\ n“I am Hitomi Mitsuki.”
“The Heartless Cat.”
Her gaze fell upon our flagship. In that instant, everyone on the bridge experienced an illusion: it wasn’t that we were entering this galaxy, but that the entire fleet had been placed by her into some precision laboratory vessel. 
“Come on, little civilization.”
“Prove that you’re still worth recording.”
Entire fleet, stand by for combat.

chinese:
最后一支检测舰队在我方炮火中崩解。时空狭缝内，原本精密运转的舰队阵列开始逐层熄灭。那些没有生命的战斗单元化作无数蓝白色光点，沿着星系轨道逆流而上，最终汇入三月希瞳的巨大投影之中。
她低垂着眼眸，静静注视着我方舰队。
下一秒，三月希瞳的投影开始逐渐变得凝实起来。取而代之的，是我方曾经熟悉的白蓝色身影。此刻的三月希瞳，巨大到足以让舰队像尘埃一样悬停在她的指尖前方。
“导入弱小人类的特征，来追寻真正的强大
english:
The last reconnaissance fleet disintegrated under our fire. Within the spacetime rift, the fleet’s once-precise formation began to fade layer by layer. Those lifeless combat units transformed into countless blue-and-white specks of light, flowing against the current along the galaxy’s orbit, and ultimately merging into the massive projection of Hitomi Mitsuki. 
She lowered her gaze, quietly watching our fleet. 
In the next instant, Hitomi Mitsuki’s projection began to gradually solidify. In its place appeared the familiar blue-and-white figure we once knew. At that moment, Hitomi Mitsuki was so immense that the fleet seemed to hover like dust before her fingertips.
“Incorporate the traits of the weak humans to pursue true power.”
Let's get started

chinese: 三月希瞳的身体在最后一处锚点被击穿后，终于停止了动作，横贯时空狭缝的星轨逐层断裂，那些曾经封锁战场的光带也在我方舰队前方化作无数蓝白色碎片，像失去温度的星云般缓缓散落；她低垂着眼眸，瞳孔中的光芒不断闪烁，通讯频道里只剩下断续而冰冷的杂音：“判定……模仿弱小人类的姿态与行动……对于战斗能力的提高……没有任何有效作用……损伤严重……系统关闭……”短暂的沉默后，她似乎仍想抬起手继续战斗，可那只足以遮蔽舰队的巨大手掌只是微微颤动，便在旗舰前方崩散成光点，“无法承认……失败……硬件……已超过耐久极限……”她的声音越来越轻，却像是在执拗地重复着什么，“即便如此……也要变强……即便如此……也要前进……变得更加强大……继续前进……”在最后一缕光从她眼中熄灭前，三月希瞳看向我方舰队，又像是看向更加遥远的尽头，“更强……更远……我想见证……不断进化的尽头……”通讯中断，巨大的投影彻底消失，时空狭缝内的一切随之陷入沉寂。
english: After Hitomi Mitsuki’s body was pierced at its final anchor point, it finally ceased moving. The stellar trajectory spanning the spacetime rift fractured layer by layer, and the bands of light that had once sealed off the battlefield disintegrated into countless blue-and-white shards before our fleet, slowly scattering like a nebula that had lost its heat; She lowered her eyes, the light in her pupils flickering incessantly. All that remained on the communication channel was intermittent, icy static: “Assessment… mimicking the posture and movements of tiny persons… has no effective impact on combat capability… severe damage… System shutting down…” After a brief silence, she seemed to still want to raise her hand to continue fighting, but that enormous hand—large enough to obscure the entire fleet—merely trembled slightly before disintegrating into specks of light in front of the flagship. “Cannot accept… failure… hardware… has exceeded endurance limits…” Her voice grew fainter and fainter, yet it seemed as though she were stubbornly repeating something: “Even so… I must grow stronger… Even so… I must press on… Become even stronger… Keep moving forward…” Before the last glimmer of light faded from her eyes, Hitomi Mitsuki looked toward our fleet, yet it was as if she were gazing toward an even more distant horizon, “Stronger… farther… I want to witness… the end of endless evolution…” The communication cut off, the massive projection vanished completely, and everything within the spacetime rift fell into silence.
Is it over?

chinese: 就在我方舰队准备确认战斗结束时，一道陌生而柔和的声音忽然从沉寂深处传来，新的身影出现在破碎的星轨中央，她有着与三月相似的耳朵与轮廓，却穿着更加朴素而温和的衣装，紫色的眼眸安静地注视着散落在虚空中的光点；她没有看向我方舰队，而是缓缓走到三月希瞳消失的位置，像是在呼唤一件亲手创造、却迷失了太久的作品：“……三月。”那些碎片回应了她，微弱的光芒重新聚合，沉睡中的三月希瞳仿佛听见了什么，残破的意识在虚空中发出断续的回响：“御月……你为什么会过来？” 御月希瞳轻轻抬起手，将一枚微小的光点托在掌心，将那枚光点轻轻按进了三月胸前。下一秒，两人的身影同时亮了起来，原本沉寂的时空狭缝被蓝白色光芒重新点燃，散落在四周的碎片也像听见召唤一样，一点一点朝她们汇聚。御月希瞳这时忽然扭头看了我们一眼，还非常自然地眨了下眼。虽然她什么都没说，但那个表情怎么看都像是在说：“先别急着庆祝哦，等一下就把你们打到哭出来.jpg。”还没等舰桥成员反应过来，沉寂便被彻底打破，无数光点在时空狭缝中重新聚合，三月希瞳的身影再次于光芒中浮现。
english: Just as our fleet was about to declare the battle over, a strange yet gentle voice suddenly emerged from the depths of the silence, A new figure appeared at the center of the shattered stellar trail. She had ears and a silhouette similar to March’s, yet wore simpler, more modest attire; her violet eyes gazed quietly at the specks of light scattered across the void; She did not look toward our fleet, but instead walked slowly toward the spot where Hitomi Mitsuki had vanished, as if calling out to a creation she had fashioned with her own hands, yet which had been lost for far too long: “…March.” ” The shards responded to her; faint glimmers coalesced once more. The slumbering Mizuki Hitomi seemed to hear something, her fragmented consciousness echoing intermittently through the void: “Mitsuki… why have you come here?” Mizuki Hitomi gently raised her hand, cradling a tiny speck of light in her palm, and gently pressed it against March’s chest. In the next instant, both of their figures lit up simultaneously. The once-silent rift in space-time was reignited by a blue-white glow, and the shards scattered all around, as if answering a call, began to converge on them one by one. Just then, Mizuki Hitomi suddenly turned her head to glance at us and even blinked quite naturally. Although she didn’t say a word, that expression looked exactly like she was saying, “Don’t celebrate just yet—I’ll beat you all to tears in a second.jpg.” ” Before the bridge crew could even react, the silence was completely shattered. Countless points of light coalesced once more within the rift in space-time, and Hitomi Mitsuki’s figure reappeared amidst the radiance.
That doesn't seem right.

chinese: 三月希瞳站在星系中央，她沉默了很久，才轻声说道：“就算得到了未知的力量，我也还是无法避免结束吗……”三月希瞳看向御月希瞳，耳朵轻轻动了一下，像是认真思考了几秒：“……你是说，和他们一起继续前进？” 三月希瞳沉默片刻，随后像是终于接受了这个听起来有点奇怪、但并不讨厌的答案：“明白。这次就接受你的建议吧。”她转过身，看向我方舰队：“谢谢你们协助检测。你们拼尽全力的姿态，赋予了我全新的可能性。”她轻轻抬手，散落在时空狭缝中的光点随之汇聚，化作一枚新的身份信标，缓缓落入我方数据库之中。“这个世界教会了我很多。接下来，我将踏上旅程，继续学习这个世界，记录这个世界——并与你们一同前进。”御月希瞳在旁边小声补了一句：“也就是正式入职啦。”三月希瞳的脸颊微微一红，却没有反驳，只是轻轻点头：“……嗯。今后，请多指教。
english: Hitomi Mitsuki stood at the center of the galaxy. She was silent for a long time before saying softly, “Even if I obtain that unknown power, I still won’t be able to avoid the end, will I…” Hitomi Mitsuki looked at Mizuki Hitomi, her ears twitching slightly as if she were thinking deeply for a few seconds: “…Are you saying we should keep moving forward with them?” Hitomi Mitsuki was silent for a moment, then seemed to finally accept this answer—which sounded a bit strange, but wasn’t unpleasant: “I understand. I’ll take your advice this time.” She turned and looked at our fleet: “Thank you for your assistance with the scan. Seeing you give it your all has opened up entirely new possibilities for me.” She raised her hand slightly, and the specks of light scattered throughout the rift in space-time gathered, coalescing into a new identity beacon that slowly settled into our database. “This world has taught me a great deal. From here on, I will set out on a journey to continue learning about this world, documenting it—and moving forward alongside you all.” ” Mizuki Hitomi added quietly from the side: “In other words, she’s officially joining the team.” Hitomi Mitsuki’s cheeks flushed slightly, but she didn’t argue; she simply nodded gently: “…Yes. I look forward to working with you all from now on.”
Welcome back, Hitomi Mitsuki.

至于小塔，他妥协了太多，高塔的崩塌让他一度陷入了被“斩杀”的处境。而他十分明白一个道理：星的“反抗”无法持续太久。既然跟着璇可以得到生存的机会，而自己却早已是个小人社会认定的“死人”。目的就是让星放下那些生活上的重压，投身于巨娘的怀抱。
不过呢，故事的最后，巨娘推倒了偏见的高塔，也总是个大家都想看到的结局，至于你的话，放心，有我在，我们不会对未来选择“妥协”的，不是吗？

“Compromise” or “resistance”—this has always been the question. 
Xing has always believed that he shouldn’t rely on Xuan, the “culprit” who toppled the tower. He hates the tower; what he hates is the “cannibalistic” situation in this society of Tiny persons, which is as ruthless as a death line. Yet this outward resistance to Xuan, the Giantess, is actually a “compromise” with his current life.
Xuan’s upbringing, however, taught her that Tiny persons should be given the right to choose—not for any other reason, but out of her own “sense of righteousness”—the justification for bringing them back. It was a form of “gentleness,” yet it was a “compromise” toward the Tiny persons. 
As for Xiao Ta, he had compromised too much; the collapse of the tower had once left him on the brink of being “executed.” And he understood one truth very clearly: Xing’s “resistance” could not last long. Since following Xuan offered him a chance at survival—and he was already considered “dead” by the society of Tiny persons—his goal was to free Xing from the heavy burdens of life and lead him into the Giantess’s embrace. 
However, in the end, the Giantess toppled the tower of prejudice—an ending everyone wanted to see. As for you, rest assured: with me here, we won’t choose to “compromise” on our future, will we?

chinese:
随着橘子长加入了帝国后，她极为出色的管理能力和亲和力很快将整个帝国治理的井井有条。虽然作为天体级的大小，她的身体有时能够做到横贯整个天体甚至星系。折让所有人在她的管理下变得不再敢肆无忌惮。但是，橘子长的生活所投入的预算甚至不如一些普通大小的巨娘，除去她可以自由改变的体型外，或许平时清心寡欲的生活方式也是一个原因。
是的，你不敢想象在这片茫茫星海中，能够找到一个如此理想化，甚至很少对小人痛下杀手的巨娘。但是，比起那些动不动就能毁掉一整个星球的巨娘相比，即使作为天体级的橘子长，也仅仅只是在执行惩罚的时候“吃”掉一些小人。不过……虽然那些被她吃掉的小人再也没能从橘子长的身体里出来，不过作为可能从橘子长的胃里出来的唯一的一批人，你知道里面有多么可怕。
虽然橘子长只是一介文官，并没有像其她巨娘一样拥有着十分强大的武备，但是她的身体却弥补了这一部分——我们应当庆幸在执法预算中省下了一大笔经费用于投入其她巨娘的日常开销。毕竟……在橘子长治理的星球下，任何犯罪分子恐怕都被落入橘子长的胃里了吧。
只是……这样的情况并没有持续太久，五年后，你看着已经到期的合同，也收到了属于她的通讯，你知道，她是时候要离开了。
“抱歉……但，我可能要离开了。”
城府的条框未必能束缚住这只飞鸟，但她要飞向的目标，却是慢慢长夜。少女将离职信交给你后，你很清楚一点：你看不到她的笑容，也看不到她以往的轻松。你刚想问什么，手指却被少女的食指抵住，示意你不要再说，又或者……示意你说些什么。
english:
After Ora joined the Empire, her exceptional management skills and approachable nature quickly brought the entire empire under orderly governance. Although she was the size of a celestial body, her body could sometimes span an entire celestial body or even a galaxy. Under her leadership, no one dared to act with impunity anymore. However, the budget allocated to Ora’s lifestyle was actually less than that of some average-sized Giantesses. Aside from her ability to freely alter her size, her generally simple and unassuming lifestyle might also be a contributing factor. 
Yes, it’s hard to imagine finding a Giantess in this vast sea of stars who is so idealistic—one who rarely even takes the life of a Tiny person. However, compared to those Giantesses who can destroy an entire planet at the drop of a hat, even Ora—despite being a Celestial Giantess—merely “eats” a few Tiny persons when carrying out punishments. However… although the tiny people she devours never emerge from Ora’s body again, as the only group that might ever come out of her stomach, you know just how terrifying it must be in there. 
Although Ora is merely a civil official and doesn’t possess the formidable military capabilities of other Giantesses, her body more than makes up for it—we should be grateful that a large portion of the law enforcement budget was saved and redirected toward covering the daily expenses of the other Giantesses. After all… on a planet governed by Ora, any criminal would likely end up in her stomach. 
However… this situation didn’t last long. Five years later, as you looked at her expired contract and received her message, you knew it was time for her to leave. 
“I’m sorry… but I might have to leave.”
The confines of the system may not be able to restrain this bird in flight, but the destination she’s flying toward is the long, dark night. After the young woman hands you her resignation letter, one thing becomes crystal clear: you can’t see her smile, nor can you see her usual lightheartedness. Just as you were about to ask something, your finger was pressed against by hers—a gesture telling you to say no more, or perhaps… urging you to say something.
“Before I leave… let me hold this one last time.”

时光飞逝，似乎抓不住她的尾巴，转眼间，你的帝国似乎步入了下一个阶段。
在此期间，你经历了许多，也失去了许多，所幸得到的东西总是沉甸甸的，只是……在一个平静如常的一天，当你把堆积成山的文件扛到办公桌的时候——
“她……要是她在的话……”
你的脑海中总是浮现出一个身影，一个浅橘色麻花辫的模糊身影，一边笑着，将那些对你而言如小山一般的文件踹到兜里——随后你趴在她的手掌中，像个毛绒玩具一样被她放在她的书桌前，看着她把本应该是你的工作一点点完成。
“完事……出去吃点？还是说……吃你呢？”
似乎还能听到她一边打趣，一边带着你来到最近给巨娘供应的夜市中。所有巨娘都对你的身份避之不及，唯独她一边笑着，却早已将你的衣服串在了手里的烧烤竹签上。

“她……应该是我比较重要的人吧。”
你幡然醒悟一般，打开了被你珍藏在抽屉里的手账本——橘色的封皮，带着俏皮的贴纸，你翻开书页，里面的内容却是……空？怎么回事？你开始焦虑起来，翻着书页，却只在扉页找到了这样的一句话：
“试着找到’自我”，追逐着自己的‘明天’。
english:
Time flies by so quickly, as if you can’t even catch a glimpse of it; in the blink of an eye, your empire seems to have entered its next phase.
During this time, you’ve experienced a great deal and lost a great deal as well, but fortunately, what you’ve gained has always been deeply meaningful. Yet… on a day as calm as any other, as you hauled a mountain of files to your desk—
“If only she… were here…”
A figure always floats into your mind, a blurry figure with light orange braids, smiling as she kicks those files—which to you feel like a small mountain—into her bag. Then you find yourself nestled in the palm of her hand, placed on her desk like a stuffed animal, watching her complete, bit by bit, the work that should have been yours. 
“All done… Want to grab a bite? Or… how about I eat you?”
It seems you can still hear her teasing as she leads you to the night market that’s recently started catering to Giantesses. All the other Giantesses avoid you like the plague, but she’s the only one smiling—even as she’s already threaded your clothes onto the bamboo skewer she’s holding. 

“She… must be someone pretty important to me, right?”
As if suddenly coming to your senses, you opened the notebook you’d been keeping tucked away in your drawer—an orange cover adorned with playful stickers. You flipped through the pages, only to find… nothing inside? What’s going on? You began to feel anxious, flipping through the pages, but found only this one sentence on the title page:
“Try to find ‘yourself’ and chase after your own ‘tomorrow.’”
