You know this planet—with that enormous straw piercing right through it. Under her governance, the original urban planning meant you didn’t have to worry too much about expenses. It’s just that… you still remember there was one area that wasn’t included in her development plans. 
“This place… let’s just consider it a little bit of private space for us…”\ nFor a Celestial Giantess to own an area of less than 500 square kilometers clearly doesn’t violate any regulations. It’s just that… she’s obviously been keeping something from you. When you arrived in this area, you discovered—
It was just a city—or, to be precise… a metropolitan area from the late stages of the Third Industrial Revolution.
Incompetence

chinese:
2021年4月 日
在自己的第18岁的第一天，我遭遇了一场重大车祸。所幸命大，但是却还是对高考产生了影响。
我已经不后悔了，被车撞飞的一瞬间，我想了很多，我似乎看到了，城市在崩坏，交通在瘫痪，似乎整个城市都在一个女孩的脚下变得如此卑微。不过……又如何呢？我这一世，什么时候低下那一直仰望的头颅？
但是……是不是……如果自己就是那个女孩子的话……
2024年12月5日
近期发生的事情很多，也很累。
倒霉的事情频频发生，我也总算在艰难维生中买了一块属于自己的pad——500块钱，却足以实现自己的梦想了吧。
那个梦中不断浮现的景象……一个麻花辫的少女，整个城市都在她的脚边，显得如此渺小。似乎她抬起脚，就足以让一个城市，一个国家，甚至整个星球都为之胆寒……
鞋底稍微厚一点吧……最好再穿个堆堆袜，这样任何人都别想爬到她的腿上……外套样式……是半搭着还是系在腰间？看看哪个更好画吧……
2025年3月16日
我无时无刻都在想着，当自己成为这个人，或者说，能够用自己的双手将其创造出来的时候。
现在，时候到了，虽然粗糙了点，但时间能慢慢打磨她。
至于名字……■■■吧。性别女，年龄17……今天就这些吧
2028年3月25日
大家好！今天是■■■的第一场首播哦~让我来看看有多少观众呢……
15个，首播就有这样的成绩，已经算不错了。再接再厉吧。
2028年4月……
这本日记的主人恐怕难以再写下去了，就由我来继续写下去吧。
就在今天，在虚拟主播■■■正式出道的15天后，我亲眼见到她在直播间里，随后突然停下了她那富有激情的演出，直到三十分钟后……我们才能够在直播间里听到微弱的救护车的声音。
她为什么不求救？我不知道，我不知道这个问题究竟是谁能够问出来。就在刚刚，她被诊断出，为急性心脏衰竭，抢救无效死亡——确切的说，是放弃抢救吧，想必她也无力承担这笔医药费就是了。
她留下的画作已成废纸，她写下的文章也被互联网冲进了垃圾堆。她的存在，她的死亡都变得那么无人在意，宛如被随意践踏的臭虫一般……
那她为什么还要追求这么虚幻的东西？
……
“我恐怕……看不到你……在群星间璀璨的一日了……”

这是你在一处旧居民房中找到的一本日记本，以及一份尚未出版的报导。这……是她吗？如果她的过去就是死亡的话……那你看到的那个天体级巨娘是——
你不敢想，却突然听到了这样一个声音——
english:
April 2021
On the very first day of my 18th year, I was involved in a serious car accident. Fortunately, I survived, but it still affected my college entrance exams. 
I no longer have any regrets. In the split second I was thrown from the car, my mind raced. It seemed as though I saw the city crumbling, traffic coming to a standstill—as if the entire city had become so insignificant at the feet of a single girl. But… so what? In this life of mine, when will I ever lower this head that’s always been held high?
But… what if… what if I were that girl myself…
December 5, 2024
A lot has happened recently, and I’m exhausted. 
Bad luck has been piling up, but I finally managed to scrape together enough to buy my own tablet—500 yuan, but surely that’s enough to make my dream come true, right?
That image that keeps popping up in my dreams… a girl with a braided ponytail, the entire city at her feet, looking so tiny. It seems that if she were to lift her foot, it would be enough to strike fear into a city, a country, or even the entire planet…
Maybe the soles of her shoes should be a little thicker… It’d be best if she wore some puffy socks too, so no one could possibly climb up her legs… As for her coat… should it be draped loosely or tied at the waist? Let’s see which one is easier to draw…
March 16, 2025
I’ve been thinking about this every single moment—about the day I become this person, or rather, the day I can create her with my own hands.
Now, the time has come. It’s a bit rough around the edges, but time will slowly polish her. 
As for her name… let’s go with ■■■. Female, age 17… That’s all for today. 
March 25, 2028
Hello, everyone! Today is ■■■’s very first live stream~ Let me see how many viewers we have…\ n15 viewers—not bad for a debut stream. Let’s keep up the good work. 
April 2028…
The author of this diary will likely be unable to continue writing, so I’ll take over. 
Just today, 15 days after virtual streamer ■■■ officially debuted, I saw her in the livestream room with my own eyes. She suddenly stopped her passionate performance, and it wasn’t until thirty minutes later… that we could hear the faint sound of an ambulance in the livestream. 
Why didn’t she call for help? I don’t know—I don’t know who could even ask that question. Just moments ago, she was diagnosed with acute heart failure and pronounced dead after resuscitation efforts failed—or, to be precise, resuscitation was abandoned. I suppose she simply couldn’t afford the medical bills. 
The paintings she left behind have become worthless scraps of paper, and the articles she wrote have been swept into the internet’s trash bin. Her existence and her death have become so insignificant to everyone, as if she were a bedbug casually trampled underfoot…
Then why did she still pursue such an illusory thing?
……
“I’m afraid… I won’t live to see the day… when you shine brilliantly among the Stars…”\ n
This is a diary you found in an old residential building, along with an unpublished report. Is this… her? If her past was nothing but death… then that Celestial Giantess you saw was—
You dared not think it, but suddenly you heard a voice saying—
I'm here—leave it to me.
Illusion

chinese:
“好久不见，大家好哦”
“停更已久的■■■，现在，化身为‘巨大娘’归来了哦~”
浅橘色的双麻花辩，却因为某个渺小的信仰，在整个星球上空浮现。整个天空宛如一块全息屏幕，而这次她的观众，则有惊人的90亿。
“好了好了，不要害怕，也不要用任何武器……咱是不会伤害大家的……”少女简单的进行了自我介绍后，消失在了群星中。而她也在寻找着一个答案，一个世间的第一问：
“我是谁？”

“我是‘收获’，是那个人所追逐的明天……”
如今，人已然不在，少女踏在了城市群中，一切都在那个人的想象中，却再也没见到其身影。
有点……讽刺。
她循着仍然存在的记忆，来到了一处旧居民楼，早已收敛些许大小的身体，却仍然有十层楼那般高，不过还好，足够了，至少能蹲下来看一下，房间里都有些什么样的存在了。
“我循着过去，但过去的相片不属于我……”
“她拒绝了我。那我是谁？”

“老板……这个手账本多少钱？”
“五块……啊怪物啊！！”
少女堵住了整个街道，只是一家文具店，在她眼中和一个烟盒差不多大小。老板惊恐的眼神中，看着被少女那加厚的鞋底堵住的门口，堵住了唯一能够逃跑的希望。
“抱歉啦……咱最小也就这样大了……钱给你……小人的收款码有点难扫……”
接过了和指甲盖大小的手账本后，却突然因为少女的力量，变得适合少女使用的大小。少女拿起了事先准备好的笔，坐在一处荒废的大楼上，看着远处的城市发呆。
“我的故事……我自己写下来吧。”

你拾起找到的残页，将一切都抄在了这个手账本中。你不知道这样做的意义为何，只是冥冥中有一种感觉……
english:
“Long time no see, everyone!”
“■■■, which has been on hiatus for a long time, is now back as ‘Giant Girl’~”
Her pale orange double braids appeared high above the entire planet, all because of a certain insignificant belief. The entire sky was like a holographic screen, and this time, her audience numbered a staggering 9 billion.
“All right, all right, don’t be afraid, and don’t use any weapons… I won’t hurt any of you…” After a brief self-introduction, the girl vanished among the Stars. And she, too, was searching for an answer—the first question in the world:
“Who am I?”

“I am ‘Harvest,’ the tomorrow that person was chasing…”
Now that the person is gone, the girl walks through the cityscape. Everything exists only in that person’s imagination, yet she has never seen his figure again. 
It’s a bit… ironic.
Guided by the memories that still lingered, she arrived at an old apartment building. Her body had shrunk somewhat, yet she was still as tall as a ten-story building. Fortunately, it was enough—at least she could crouch down to see what was inside the rooms. 
“I follow the past, but the photographs of the past don’t belong to me…”
“She rejected me. Then who am I?”

“Sir… how much is this notebook?”\ n“Five yuan… Oh my God, a monster!!”
The girl blocked the entire street—it was just a stationery store, but to her, it looked about the size of a cigarette pack. The shopkeeper’s eyes widened with terror as he watched the girl’s thickened shoe soles block the doorway, cutting off his only hope of escape. 
“Sorry about that… this is the smallest size I have… Here’s your money… my QR code is a bit hard to scan…”
After taking the notebook—which was no bigger than a fingernail—it suddenly changed to a size suitable for the girl, thanks to her power. The girl picked up the pen she’d prepared in advance, sat atop an abandoned building, and stared blankly at the city in the distance. 
“My story… I’ll write it down myself.”

You picked up the scattered pages you’d found and copied everything into this notebook. You didn’t know the meaning behind doing this; you just had a vague feeling deep down…

chinese:
无忆虚构的梦界，众星尽头的救赎，信念堆成的高塔……
少女化作勇者，冲向笔下的风车，而做完这一切后，她合上书本，因为……
脚下来了一群不速之客。
少女来到这个世界并没有毁坏任何东西，除了时不时来到城市街道买点东西的行为让人们有点恐慌以外，更多的时间还是坐在那片废弃城区中。在那片破败的砖瓦中，似乎只有这片远离人间的地方，可以成为她笔下生花的土壤。只是……
似乎这里也不是她的容身之所。

“不管你从何而来……请你速速离开地球，否则……”

赤裸裸的孤立，对异体的排斥，这似乎是生物本能的反应，或者说……是来自于渺小的恐慌，而此刻，却化作一颗155mm的炮弹，被少女单手接下。看着脚下的铁皮盒子，少女叹了口气。
因为这是第六次如此，也是她最后的耐心了。
丢掉指尖的小石子，少女站起身，轻轻抬起了自己的鞋子——制造它的主人刻意将鞋底做的相当厚实，恐怕就是为了踩掉这些烦人的小东西吧。
“怪物已经有了攻击反应，开火……诶诶？别跑！”
鞋子轻轻压在了铁皮盒子的顶端，稍稍用力，却宛如随处可见的塑料瓶一般，丝毫没有感觉到有什么生命的存在，而那个站在铁皮盒子顶端的小家伙……则被少女捏了起来，仔细端详着。
黄昏为少女的麻花辫蒙上了一层橘红，却将少女的侧颜勾勒上了一笔绝美的色彩，只是少女并不知道自己竟有如此魅力，只是在想……为什么这个小家伙的心脏会跳的这么快？扑通——扑通——原来把这些小家伙捏住是这种感觉吗？
软软的，似乎轻轻一捏就会碎掉一样……手指想捏的稍微轻一点，却又害怕会突然松手让小家伙滑下去，总之，这样的小生物在自己指间挣扎，引起了少女的兴趣。她想尝试着沟通一下……哪怕没有任何人去回应。但是……她想发声。
“那个……你好？”
“别吃我别吃我……”
少女想多了，却突然提醒了她：“吃？……什么是吃呢？“少女曾在想这种问题，似乎从她诞生起，就没有过要进食的设定。那种……可以把东西塞进嘴里，吞咽，随后在胃里消化掉食物的感觉……不如先从这个小家伙试试呢？
少女如此想着，张开了口，粉嫩的口腔毫无吝啬地在小人面前，展示着自己生杀予夺的权利，洁白的牙床，颤动的喉花，从上颚处往下滴落的唾液，在口腔间形成的拉丝，宛如溶洞一般，却带着一股柑橘的芬芳。
松开手指，已经能感觉到舌尖有一个微小物体落入了此处。顺着舌苔的蠕动慢慢往深处滑下，能感受到小人挣扎的感觉，宛如在深海中溺水的船员一般，只能看着漆黑的海底在一点一点地吞噬着自己……让自己不再是自己，而是化为某些东西的一部分……

“她……她是吃人了吧……她尝到咱们的味道了……”
“我们……都会被她吃掉吗……我不想被吃掉啊……”

食之无味，却宛如伊甸园的苹果一般，令人难以回头。少女舔了舔嘴角，开始往围观的人群靠近，人们四散逃开，却心怀绝望。此刻，这些小人已然不再是生物链的顶端，而是某个少女的“零食”。

她……曾有过这样的一面吗？
你不敢想，回过头仰望时，却看到远处那根矗立在远方的巨大吸管。你站在这片荒芜的废弃城区中，见到了她所看到的景象，也如她一般，记下了她的故事
english:
A dreamworld devoid of memory, redemption at the end of the stars, a tower built upon faith…
The girl transforms into a hero and charges toward the windmill on the page, and after doing all this, she closes the book, because…
A group of uninvited guests has arrived at her feet. 
The girl’s arrival in this world had not caused any destruction. Aside from the occasional panic she sparked among the people when she ventured into the city streets to buy a few things, she spent most of her time sitting in that abandoned district. Amid those crumbling bricks and tiles, it seemed that only this place—far removed from the world of mortals—could serve as fertile ground for the flowers of her imagination. Yet…
It seemed this place was not a safe haven for her either.

“No matter where you come from… please leave Earth immediately, or else…”\ n
Blatant isolation, rejection of the other—this seemed to be a biological instinct, or perhaps… a reaction born of petty fear. Yet at this moment, it took the form of a 155mm shell, which the girl caught with one hand. Looking down at the metal box at her feet, she sighed. 
This was the sixth time this had happened, and her patience had finally run out.
Flinging the small pebble from her fingertip, the girl stood up and gently lifted her shoe—its creator had deliberately made the sole quite thick, likely just to crush these annoying little things underfoot.
 “The monster has shown an aggressive response. Open fire… Hey, hey? Don’t run!”
Her shoe gently pressed down on the top of the tin box. She applied a little pressure, but it felt just like any ordinary plastic bottle—she sensed no sign of life whatsoever. As for the little creature standing on top of the tin box… …was picked up by the girl, who examined it closely. 
The twilight cast an orange-red glow over the girl’s braids, outlining her profile in a stunning hue. Yet she was unaware of her own charm; she was simply wondering… why was this little creature’s heart beating so fast? Thump—thump—so this is what it feels like to hold one of these little creatures?
It’s so soft, as if it might shatter with the slightest squeeze… Her fingers wanted to squeeze a little more gently, yet she was afraid that if she suddenly let go, the little creature would slip away. In any case, seeing such a tiny creature struggling between her fingers piqued the girl’s curiosity. She wanted to try communicating with it… even if no one would respond. But… she wanted to speak. 
“Um… hello?”
“Don’t eat me, don’t eat me…”
The girl had let her imagination run wild, but it suddenly struck her: “Eat?… What does it mean to eat?” She’d been pondering this question for a while—it seemed she’d never been programmed to eat since the day she was born. That feeling… of being able to put something in your mouth, swallow it, and then digest it in your stomach… Why not try it out on this Tiny person first?
With that thought, the girl opened her mouth. Her pink, delicate mouth generously displayed its power of life and death before the Tiny person, her pearly white gums, her quivering soft palate, and the saliva dripping from her upper palate—forming threads within her mouth—resembled a cave, yet carried a citrusy fragrance.
As she released her grip, she could already feel a tiny object settle on the tip of her tongue. As it slid deeper along the undulating surface of her tongue, she could sense the Tiny person struggling—like a sailor drowning in the deep sea, forced to watch as the pitch-black ocean floor swallowed him up bit by bit… transforming him from himself into a part of something else…

 “She… she’s eating people, isn’t she… she’s tasted our flavor…”
“Are we… all going to be eaten by her… I don’t want to be eaten…”

It had no taste, yet like the apple from the Garden of Eden, it was impossible to turn back. The girl licked her lips and began to approach the onlookers. People scattered in all directions, yet their hearts were filled with despair. At this moment, these tiny people were no longer at the top of the food chain—they had become a “snack” for a certain girl. \ n
Did she… ever have this side to her?
You dared not think about it, but when you turned and looked up, you saw that enormous straw standing tall in the distance. Standing in this desolate, abandoned urban area, you witnessed the same scene she did, and just like her, you recorded her story.

chinese:
少女离开了她诞生的星球，她开始了她的旅程。只是临走前，出于自己的小私心，她随手拾起了漂浮在宇宙间的吸管，插在了星球的海面上。
巨大的白色吸管上到天际，向下直插地心，人们都看到少女的所作所为，却无人敢为之发声。曾几何时，这些人曾经向一个如此巨大的身影孤立，而如今，当少女做出了她想做的事情之后，所有人都意识到了一个问题：
漫长的无神之路早已让这些渺小的生物感到安逸，而当这个星球迎来了属于他们的神明时——她却将生杀的权利交给小人自己决定。
她已无心以小人的痛苦为乐，这根插在星球上的吸管也仅仅只是为了警告——顺带在心情不好的时候嘬一口。而她选择离开这里，只是为了能完成某个人临终前对自己的遗愿。
“在群星璀璨。”
她见过了太多，她看到无数人崇拜在以数个星系联结而成的巨娘身边，只为求得她性欲开始的一瞬吞没他们的帝国。她看到有无数巨娘，仗着横跨数个大陆的身体，践踏着才刚刚完成石器时代的渺小土著。她看到小人将自己视若神明，也不止一次从比自己还要大的多的巨娘手中逃生。少女手握长伞，怀揣手账，在群星间将所经历的一切都一一记录下来。
她知道无数神明，她们甚至超出了这个维度本身。亦或是她所见到的也只是她们所投射到这个世界的模样。她不想这样，却无能为力，她为此表示恐慌，却仍然带着这份情感前行。

“你看上去……不太像是天体级的巨娘啊……”
“怎么见得？”
“在这里这么久……一个小人都没ub……小妹妹不能是处……”

少女难得的震惊，整个星球，甚至比星球还要大的多的巨娘，数以万计地在遥远的淫口前鱼贯而入。只是远远的看着，少女手扶长伞，这才勉强稳住身影没有因此晕倒。
每片星海都有自己的传统，少女理解，少女尊重，可心底里这份恐慌却怎么都挥之不去。因为就算再怎么隐瞒自己，少女都不得不开始重视起一个问题：
她和别人的差距太大了。
故事到此，却突然戛然而止。你走到海岸边，看着那根庞然大物的吸管。似乎还能听到她做下这一切时的心情——那种被众人孤立的痛楚。
你知道，她还在帝国的那段时间，她忙前忙后，忙着和周边各个国家的使节打交道。你很难想象她沉默寡言的样子，也很少看到她摧毁过什么城市或者星球。
越是被孤立过，就越是对已经获得的感情更加珍惜。甚至到了小心翼翼的程度，所以，如果不是有什么很重要的事情的话……
“那她当初为什么选择离开呢？”
以及，还有一个从一开始就想提出的问题
english:
The young girl left the planet where she was born and set out on her journey. But just before she left, out of her own selfish motives, she casually picked up a straw floating in space and stuck it into the ocean on the planet’s surface. 
The enormous white straw reached up to the sky and plunged straight down to the planet’s core. Everyone witnessed what the girl had done, yet no one dared to speak out. Once upon a time, these people had stood alone against such a colossal figure, but now, after the girl had done as she pleased, everyone realized a problem:\ nThe long path of godlessness had long lulled these insignificant creatures into complacency, and when this planet finally welcomed a deity of its own—she handed the power of life and death over to Tiny persons to decide for themselves. 
She no longer took pleasure in the suffering of these Tiny persons; the straw stuck into the planet served merely as a warning—and, incidentally, to take a sip from when she was in a bad mood. Her decision to leave this place was simply to fulfill the dying wish of someone who had entrusted it to her.
“Amid the glittering Stars.”\ nShe had seen too much. She had witnessed countless people worshipping a Giantess formed by the convergence of several galaxies, merely to beg for her empire—which would engulf them the moment her lust was aroused. She had seen countless Giantesses, relying on bodies that spanned several continents, trampling the tiny indigenous peoples who had only just emerged from the Stone Age. She saw tiny people regard her as a deity, and more than once, she escaped from the clutches of Giantesses far larger than herself. The young girl, holding a long umbrella and carrying a notebook, recorded everything she experienced among the Stars. 
She knew of countless deities—beings that transcended this dimension itself. Or perhaps what she saw were merely the forms they projected into this world. She didn’t want it to be this way, yet she was powerless to change it; she felt panic at the thought, yet she continued onward, carrying this emotion with her. 

“You don’t really look… like a celestial-level Giantess…”
“How so?”
“You’ve been here this long… and haven’t ‘ub’d’ a single Tiny person… Little sister, you can’t be a virgin…”\ n
The girl was, for once, genuinely shocked. Across the entire planet—and even beyond, into the vast expanse far larger than the planet itself—tens of thousands of Giantesses were streaming one after another into the distant, lewd orifice. Just watching from afar, the girl leaned on her long umbrella, barely managing to steady herself and avoid fainting. 
Every star sea has its own traditions; the girl understood this, and she respected them, yet the panic deep within her heart simply would not go away. Because no matter how much she tried to hide it from herself, she could no longer ignore one issue:
The gap between her and everyone else was simply too vast. 
The story ends here, coming to an abrupt halt. You walk to the shore and gaze at that colossal straw. It seems you can still hear the emotions she felt as she did all this—the pain of being isolated by everyone. 
You know that during her time in the Empire, she was constantly on the go, busy dealing with envoys from neighboring nations. It’s hard to imagine her as a quiet, reserved person, and you rarely saw her destroy any cities or planets. 
The more isolated one has been, the more one cherishes the affection one has gained. To the point of being extremely cautious—so unless it’s something truly important…
“Then why did she choose to leave in the first place?”
And there’s another question I’ve wanted to ask from the very beginning
“Who is she?”

She willingly abandoned everything.

She was just one step away from the endpoint she had reached; all she had to do was cast aside the past entirely and retain only the “endpoint”…\ nShe hesitated, for this raised a single question:
“Who am I?”
If all the planks of a ship were stripped away, leaving only an empty keel, would anyone still recognize it as a ship? The same principle applies. If she were to cast aside every story that belonged to her, would she still exist in this world? She hesitated, and after a moment’s thought, she decided:
She wanted to go home—to return to that lonely star. 

You already know the rest of the story: after she returned, she accidentally swallowed an Imperial research vessel. And that’s when you and she first met. 在经历了众多苦难中，你终于看到了橘子长的存在，但是……

身高……天体级的身高难以界定，而身上的衣服也随之发生了变化，而外套却变得破破烂烂，上面的各种装饰也彻底遗失，只是将外套挂在了身后，一手巨剑，一手战旗，在看到你的到来后，却选择将你护在身后——即使你已经感觉到她早已力竭。

“你说过的，我们终有一日‘重逢’……就是这个时间段，有点不合时宜……”
“无碍，你来的正是时候……”
声音都变得有点疲惫，却有种抹平了棱角的成熟感。“你带来了……我的‘过去’，和……‘现在’？”你将那本手账递给了橘子长，哪怕要抵抗着天体级巨娘的引力，而橘子长也随之一笑，收下了这份原本就属于她的东西。
“不过确实有个不合时宜的家伙……不过这一切该结束了……”
“自我”的炉火即将熄灭，而你的到来却让其燃烧的比以往还要明亮，少女刺向伪神，身躯也逐渐变得庞大，开始逐渐覆盖星系，覆盖了数个银河，直到绵延至宇宙边界，将那个想取代自己的家伙一口吞下。
“我曾是一个学校的普通学生……但旅程和伙伴能够让我直面神明。”
“我也在孤星的监狱中孤身一人，但监狱外仍有联结的羁绊”
“我知道虚构的梦终有一天消散……但却是现实外最温柔的避风港。”
“任何生物都会恐慌，恐慌未知，恐慌强大……但总有人挺身而出。”
“而走过了这一切的我……又有什么伪证来质疑我作为‘自我’，作为‘橘子长’的意义？”
头顶的光环逐渐浮现，一侧的瞳孔也沦为了靛蓝。环状星系开始生成，却以少女的头部作为了恒星，绕其公转……不知道为什么，你的内心十分复杂，似乎……有些对不住这位你曾经的行政官。

“但是不用担心，未来是过去的未来……我走过的，你总有一天会经历到，或者经历比这精彩的多的旅程。”
将小橘子长安抚完后，橘子长看向了你，虽然对方的体型比以往大了不少，而视线对上她瞳孔的那一刻你就明白：她仍然是你熟悉的那个存在。

english:
“Ora?”
After enduring countless hardships, you finally caught sight of Ora, but…
She’s changed… quite a bit.
Her height… is so immense it’s hard to gauge, and her clothes have changed accordingly, though her outer coat is now tattered and worn. and all its decorations have been completely lost. She simply drapes the coat behind her, holding a giant sword in one hand and a battle flag in the other. Upon seeing you arrive, she chooses to shield you behind her—even though you can sense she is already completely exhausted. 
Not a single star remained in the sky; they had all been reduced to dust in the battle. Standing opposite Ora was a figure identical to her current self—yet with indigo-blue pupils.
“You said we would ‘meet again’ one day… It’s just that this timing is a bit inopportune…”
“It doesn’t matter. You’ve come at just the right time…”
Her voice had taken on a hint of weariness, yet it carried a mature quality that smoothed out any rough edges. “Have you brought… my ‘past,’ and… my ‘present’?” You handed the notebook to Ora, even as you struggled against the gravity of a Celestial Giantess, and Ora smiled in response, accepting what had always belonged to her. 
“Though there really is one untimely fellow… but all of this should come to an end…”
 The flame of the “Self” was about to die out, but your arrival made it burn brighter than ever before. The girl lunged at the pseudo-god, her body gradually growing immense, expanding to cover a galaxy, then several galaxies, until it stretched to the very edge of the universe, swallowing whole the one who sought to replace her. 
“I used to be an ordinary student at a school… but my journey and my companions have allowed me to stand face-to-face with the gods.”
“I was alone in the prison of the Lonely Star, but even outside those walls, bonds of connection remained.”
“I know that fictional dreams will one day fade away… but they are the gentlest refuge beyond reality.”
“Every living being feels panic—panic at the unknown, panic at the powerful… but there’s always someone who steps forward.”\ n“And having gone through all of this… what false evidence could possibly call into question my significance as the ‘Self,’ as ‘Ora?’”
A halo gradually appeared above her head, and one of her pupils turned indigo. A ring galaxy began to form, with the girl’s head serving as its star, orbiting around it… For some reason, your heart felt incredibly conflicted; it seemed… as if you owed this former administrator of yours an apology. 
“Don’t worry… it’s all been resolved… or is it that… the ‘you’ of now—or rather, you—is also ‘panicking’ about something?” 
It seemed like she was comforting you, or perhaps comforting Mora. In any case, the girl’s fingers wrapped around Mora’s body; it was just a simple hug, yet it gave Mora a sense of security unlike anything she’d ever felt before. 
“I know… we’ve both walked through the same darkness…”
“But don’t worry—the future is the future of the past… What I’ve been through, you’ll experience one day—or perhaps you’ll embark on a journey far more exciting than this.”\ nAfter comforting Mora, Ora turned to look at you. Although her frame had grown considerably larger than before, the moment your gaze met hers, you knew: she was still the person you knew so well.
“How should I put this… After someone has stubbornly quit their job for decades… shouldn’t they…”
“Welcome home, Ora.”

在那片阴影的轮廓中，通过通讯，我们看见了一双大到难以形容的、粉色眼眸，正隔着云层，带着几分好奇，俯瞰着这片冰封的大地与地面上那如尘埃般的研究员们
“哎呀——”
“这颗小星球上居然还有活着的小家伙在到处乱跑呢啊~”那道巨大的身影缓缓下降。冰原上的积雪被那股从天而降的气流卷起，形成一圈圈白气浪向四周扩散
当那双粉色的眼眸终于从云层中完整地显现出来时，所有人都不由自主地屏住了呼吸
一位大得能一手攥住整片天空的少女。
她的面容精致而柔和，白色的短发在冰冷的空气中缓缓飘散，整个人看起来就像是从某本童话书中走出来的文学少女——如果忽略她那如山脉般横亘于天际的庞大身躯的话

However, just as they were less than two hundred meters from the estate’s gates, a shadow suddenly engulfed the entire sky.
It was the breathtakingly massive silhouette of a young girl, gliding slowly overhead. The once-azure sky was instantly obscured; the sunlight was completely swallowed up, and the entire ice plain was plunged into gloomy shadow. The advance team’s communicators were instantly flooded with static and interference, and everyone’s heart seemed to stop beating for a moment\ nThrough the outline of that shadow, via the communicators, we saw a pair of indescribably large, pink eyes peering down through the clouds with a touch of curiosity at the frozen landscape and the researchers on the ground, who looked as tiny as specks of dust
“Oh my—” 
“Whoa—there are actually little creatures running around on this tiny planet~” The enormous figure slowly descended. The snow on the ice plain was swept up by the air current descending from the sky, forming concentric rings of white mist that spread out in all directions\ nWhen those pink eyes finally emerged fully from the clouds, everyone instinctively held their breath
A girl so vast she could clasp the entire sky in one hand. 
Her features were delicate and gentle, her short white hair drifting slowly in the icy air. She looked just like a literary girl who had stepped out of a fairy tale—if one ignored her massive frame, which stretched across the horizon like a mountain range.

chinese:
寒岭，一座藏于山中的小镇，顾名思义，每到冬季便迎来刺骨透心的严寒。那些在南边大都市被人们视为奇迹的“泼水成冰”，在这里不过是稀松平常的景象。
寒字如此，岭字亦如其名。小镇被群山环抱，交通不便，信号也差——按常理推断，这里本该是人烟稀少、信息闭塞的贫穷之地。
然而，现实有时与常理背道而驰。
寒岭，竟是整个宁古塔地区交通最便利、外来人口最多的地方。虽不敢说每天，但每周都有不少来自南方富庶地区的豪商，开着加长车或私人飞机抵达此地。而他们唯一的目的地，便是山脚下的那座小山庄。
山庄规模不大，说是山庄，其实不过一座四合院的大小。但它风景秀丽，气温宜人，景观更是超脱现实。
倘若向池塘望去，只见碧波荡漾，莲叶成片。要知道，此时正值隆冬，又是在天寒地冻的宁古塔地区，能让池塘不结冰、植物仍然绿意盎然，近乎天方夜谭。可这座小山庄偏偏做到了。初来乍到的人只能暗自诧异，但与后面的景象相比，这点奇事便只能归为“特殊的保温科技”了。
顺着人流望向山庄主屋，满目皆是古色古香。这家店，正是一家古董店——只不过，是举世闻名的古董店。
“老板，今天有没有啥好东西啊？”
“有的，这位客人。”
循着交谈声向店内望去，只见一位白发少女坐在前台，看模样不过十八有余。然而，她从容应对着台前数不清的富商，身上看不出半分稚嫩之气；她对文物的熟悉程度，也不像一位少女，倒像是在这一行摸爬滚打多年的老手。
她手拿一尊精美的时钟，通底为金石所制，又有花鸟点缀，而表盘上又有着美轮美奂的假山，青金石所制的瀑布更是巧夺天工。此物一出，门外令人诧异的诸多景象，便只能沦为背景板了。
正当那些富商准备争抢之时，少女的一句话，却引得他们悻悻而去。
“好了，各位来客，天色已晚，小店要打烊了。大家快些回去吧。”
听到少女的话后，虽有人低声抱怨，却都识趣地离开了。尽管此刻不过下午，却没人敢闹事。即便心有不甘的人，也只是畏惧地瞥一眼面前的少女——那神情不像是敬畏，更像是害怕。
english:
Hanling, a small town nestled in the mountains, lives up to its name—every winter, it is gripped by a biting, bone-chilling cold. The phenomenon of “water turning to ice upon contact,” which people in the big cities to the south regard as a miracle, is nothing out of the ordinary here. 
Just as the character “Han” (Cold) suggests, so does the character “Ling” (Ridge). The town is surrounded by mountains, with poor transportation and spotty cell service—by all logic, this should be a sparsely populated, isolated, and impoverished place.
However, reality sometimes defies logic. 
Hanling is, in fact, the most accessible place in the entire Ningguta region and the one with the largest population of outsiders. While I wouldn’t go so far as to say it happens every day, every week sees quite a few wealthy businesspeople from the prosperous southern regions arriving here in stretch limousines or private jets. And their sole destination is that small mountain villa at the foot of the hills. 
The estate is not large; though called an estate, it is actually no bigger than a traditional courtyard house. Yet it boasts beautiful scenery, a pleasant climate, and a landscape that seems almost otherworldly.
Looking out over the pond, one sees rippling emerald waters and expanses of lotus leaves. Keep in mind that this is the dead of winter, and we’re in the freezing region of Ningguta. For a pond to remain unfrozen and the plants to stay lush and green is almost like a fairy tale. Yet this small mountain villa has managed to pull it off. First-time visitors can’t help but be secretly amazed, but compared to what lies ahead, this minor wonder can only be attributed to “special insulation technology.”
Following the flow of people toward the villa’s main house, the scene is steeped in antique charm. This shop is, in fact, an antique store—albeit one that is world-renowned. 
“Owner, do you have anything special today?”
“Yes, I do, my guest.”
Looking into the store where the conversation was taking place, I saw a white-haired young woman sitting at the front desk; she appeared to be barely over eighteen. Yet she handled the countless wealthy merchants at the counter with composure, showing not a trace of youthfulness; her familiarity with antiquities didn’t seem like that of a young girl, but rather that of a veteran who had been in the business for many years. 
She held an exquisite clock in her hands, its case crafted from gold and stone and adorned with floral and bird motifs, while the dial featured a magnificent rockery; the lapis lazuli waterfall was a masterpiece of craftsmanship. The moment this piece was unveiled, the many astonishing sights outside the door were reduced to mere backdrops. 
Just as the wealthy merchants were about to scramble for it, a single remark from the young girl sent them away, grumbling under their breath.
“All right, guests, it’s getting late, and my shop is about to close. Please hurry home.”
Upon hearing the young woman’s words, though some murmured complaints, they all tactfully took their leave. Although it was still only the afternoon, no one dared to cause a scene. Even those who felt resentful could only cast a fearful glance at the young woman before them—an expression that seemed less like reverence and more like sheer fear.

“咚咚咚。”
“雯雯，我来啦。”
轻柔的敲门声过后，一声温柔的呼唤传来。而这声音的主人，便是那少女为何下午就打烊的主要原因了。
门开的瞬间，秦雯还没来得及说话，就被一把抱住了。
“哎呀，想死你了！”
海柠整个人挂在她身上，像只小猫般蹭着她的颈窝。夕阳从身后斜斜照进来，给那头雪白的长发镀上一层暖融融的金边，连带着整个门厅都明亮了几分。
秦雯微微一僵——她总是这样，无论被抱多少次，第一反应都是不知所措。但她没有躲，只是轻轻拍了拍海柠的背，小声说：“回来了就好。”然后，她踮起脚，娇羞地在海柠脸颊上落下一个吻。
“就这？”海柠松开她，佯装不满地鼓起脸，“我跑了一整天，你就亲一下？”
秦雯抬眼看着她。海柠今天穿了一件米白色的棉袄，衬得本就出众的五官愈发柔和，眉眼间全是明媚的笑意——她天生就是这样的人，走到哪里都是焦点，随便一站就能让整条街亮起来。
而自己呢？
秦雯下意识往后挪了挪。她知道自己是什么样的人——白发在寒岭不算稀罕，但她这头白发总是被人忽略，连同她这个人一起。从小到大，她习惯了坐在教室角落不被点名，习惯了分组时最后一个被想起，习惯了明明站在人群中央，却像透明的一样。
但海柠不一样。
海柠是那种一进门就会被所有人注视的人。她的光芒不是刻意张扬，而是自然而然地流淌出来，让人忍不住想靠近。当初她转学到寒岭时，全班都轰动了，男生女生争着跟她做朋友。而秦雯只是远远地看着，心想：这样的人，跟自己不会有任何交集。
可海柠偏偏走向了她。
“嗨，”海柠伸手在她眼前晃了晃，“又发呆。在想什么？”
english:
“Knock, knock, knock.”
“Wenwen, I’m here.”\ nAfter a soft knock on the door, a gentle voice called out. The owner of that voice was the very reason why the young girl had closed up shop early that afternoon.
The moment the door opened, before Qinwen could even say a word, she was swept into an embrace.
“Oh my gosh, I’ve missed you so much!”\ nKaining hung onto her, rubbing against the crook of her neck like a little kitten. The setting sun streamed in at an angle from behind, casting a warm golden glow over her long, snow-white hair and brightening the entire entryway. 
Qinwen stiffened slightly—she was always like this; no matter how many times she was hugged, her first reaction was always to feel flustered. But she didn’t pull away; she just patted Kaining’s back gently and whispered, “I’m just glad you’re back.” Then, standing on tiptoe, she shyly planted a kiss on Kaining’s cheek. 
“Is that it?” Kaining let go of her and puffed out her cheeks in feigned displeasure. “I’ve been running around all day, and that’s all you give me—just one kiss?”
Qinwen looked up at her. Today, Kaining was wearing an off-white cotton jacket, which made her already striking features appear even softer; her eyes and brows were filled with a radiant smile—she was naturally that kind of person, the center of attention wherever she went, capable of lighting up an entire street just by standing there. 
And what about herself?
Qinwen instinctively shifted a step back. She knew exactly what kind of person she was—white hair wasn’t uncommon in Hanling, but her own white hair was always overlooked, along with her very presence. From childhood onward, she’d grown accustomed to sitting in the corner of the classroom without being called on, to being the last one remembered when dividing into groups, and to standing right in the middle of a crowd yet feeling as if she were invisible. 
But Kaining was different. 
Kaining was the kind of person who drew everyone’s attention the moment she walked in. Her radiance wasn’t刻意 showy; it flowed naturally, making people want to draw closer. When she first transferred to Hanling, the whole class was abuzz, with both boys and girls vying to be her friend. Qinwen just watched from afar, thinking to herself: Someone like that would never have anything to do with me. 
But Kaining walked right up to her. 
“Hey,” Kaining said, waving her hand in front of Qinwen’s face. “Daydreaming again. What are you thinking about?”

chinese:
秦雯回过神，脸微微发烫：“没、没什么。”
“骗人。”海柠凑近看她，忽然笑了，“你每次发呆都是在想‘我这种人怎么会有人理’，对不对？”
秦雯被说中了心事，垂下眼不说话。
海柠轻笑一声，伸手捧起她的脸，让她看着自己：“怎么会没人理呢？我理呀。
秦雯张了张嘴，什么都说不出来。
海柠的拇指轻轻摩挲着她的脸颊，像揉面团似的搓了搓，把秦雯的小脸搓得跟番茄一样红。
秦雯眼眶有些发酸。她想说“谢谢”，可那几个字堵在喉咙里，怎么也说不出口。
“好啦好啦，”海柠捏捏她的鼻尖，“你有人在意的好不好？我不是人吗？这辈子当你同桌，下辈子还当你同桌，够不够？”
秦雯被她逗笑了，用力眨了眨眼，把感动的泪意憋回去：“哪有人自己说自己不是人的。”
海柠理直气壮：“为了你，不是人就不是人。”
秦雯看着她，忽然觉得心底那片总也填不满的空洞，被什么东西一点点暖热了。
其实海柠不知道——在海柠眼里，秦雯是那个唯一不会被她光芒灼伤的人。从南方城市辗转来到寒岭那年，她见过太多冲着她笑脸凑上来的人。只有秦雯，安安静静地坐在角落，既不刻意靠近，也不刻意疏远。她递过去半块橡皮，秦雯接过来，小声说“谢谢”，然后认真地在卷子上改起了错题。
那一刻她就知道，这个存在感极低的女孩，是唯一能让她放下所有防备的人。
“那……”秦雯红着脸，小声说，“那就再亲你一口。”
她凑过去，对准海柠的脸蛋，像小鸡啄米似的，轻轻啄了一下，又一下。
海柠的脸被亲得又红又热，却笑得比谁都开心。她伸手把秦雯揽进怀里，下巴抵在她发顶，声音软得像化开的糖：“这才像话嘛。”
“小柠，走吧，回房间”
“好！”
在秦雯的房间里，二人又玩了很长一段时间才沉沉睡去，睡觉的时候，仍是抱在一起的呢
在这个世界上，这二人的故事已告一段落，不过，在一个未知的地方，以这二人为主角的史诗才刚刚开始，还是以一整个世界为舞台的状烈史诗
english:
Qinwen snapped back to reality, her face flushing slightly: “N-nothing.”
“You’re lying.” Kaining leaned in to look at her and suddenly smiled. “Every time you zone out, you’re thinking, ‘How could anyone possibly care about someone like me?’ Isn’t that right?”\ nQinwen, her innermost thoughts laid bare, lowered her eyes and remained silent.
Kaining chuckled softly, reached out to cup her face, and made her look at her: “How could no one pay attention to you? I do, after all.”
Qinwen opened her mouth but couldn’t say a word. 
Kaining’s thumb gently traced her cheek, kneading it as if working dough, until Qinwen’s face turned as red as a tomato. 
Qinwen’s eyes stung a little. She wanted to say “thank you,” but the words were stuck in her throat, and she just couldn’t get them out.
“All right, all right,” Kaining pinched the tip of her nose. “You do have someone who cares about you, don’t you? Aren’t I a person? I’ll be your desk partner in this life, and I’ll be your desk partner in the next—is that enough?”
Qinwen was amused by her words. She blinked hard to hold back the tears of emotion: “No one would ever say they aren’t a person.”\ nKaining declared with absolute conviction: “For you, if I’m not human, then I’m not human.”
Qinwen looked at her and suddenly felt that void deep within her heart—one that had always been impossible to fill—being warmed, little by little, by something. 
In truth, Kaining didn’t know—in her eyes, Qinwen was the only person who wouldn’t be scorched by her radiance. That year, when she’d made her way from a southern city to Hanling, she’d seen far too many people approaching her with fake smiles. Only Qinwen sat quietly in the corner, neither deliberately drawing near nor keeping her distance. When she handed her half an eraser, Qinwen took it, whispered “Thank you,” and then earnestly began correcting the mistakes on her exam paper. 
In that moment, she knew that this girl, whose presence was barely noticeable, was the only one who could make her let down all her defenses.
“Well…” Qinwen said softly, her face flushing, “Then I’ll kiss you one more time.”\ nShe leaned in, aiming for Kaining’s cheek, and, like a chick pecking at grain, gave her a gentle peck, then another. 
Kaining’s face grew red and warm from the kisses, yet she was smiling more happily than anyone else. She reached out to pull Qinwen into her arms, resting her chin on the top of her head, her voice as soft as melting sugar: “Now that’s more like it.”
“Little Kaining, let’s go back to the room.”
“Okay!”\ nIn Qinwen’s room, the two played together for quite a while longer before finally drifting off into a deep state of slumber—still clinging to each other as they slept. 
In this world, the story of these two has come to a close. However, in an unknown place, an epic featuring them as the protagonists has only just begun—a grand, sweeping saga set against the backdrop of an entire world.

“呼呼  啊~哈”
伴随着一声少女的哈欠，海柠缓缓睁开双眼，湖绿色的眸子一闪一闪，在寻找着秦雯的踪迹，不过，秦雯没找到，她脚边的丝丝骚痒感就让海柠忍无可忍，于是便低下头一看...
那是一整个小小的街区，古代的小茅草屋，远处的亭台楼阁，还有几个虫子大小手持农具，朝着海柠穿着白袜的小脚奋力挥砍的农民，看着样式，像是秦雯所为，不过，秦雯大体是没有这种能力的，所以海柠也——
“呼，这一定是个梦吧...”
“如果是梦的话...那...可以踩着玩了吧...”
温柔的声音所伴随着的是那50多米高的白袜嫩足微微移动，那些渺小的农人也是毫无悬念的成为了海柠脚下绽放的血色花朵了
“唔...这么一下...就”
“我杀人了...不对，这是梦里...呼”
“如果是梦里的话，那那些建筑...”
就像是验证她的想法一样，本来侧身躺下的海柠瞬势站了起来，不站还好，她站立之时，那300米的身体就使得那些小人全部跪了下去，毕竟，300高的尺度对于古代来说，已经是不可能达到的尺度，没有飞机，没有高楼大厦，海柠此时的身高也与神明无异了
“呼，都好小啊，不仔细找跟本看不清呢...先试着走两步吧”海柠小心翼翼地挪动了一下脚。
那动作在她自己看来，不过是轻轻地把脚往前探了探，甚至连脚踝都没完全抬起。但对于脚下那片世界而言，却像是一整片天空忽然压低了下来，白袜包裹着的脚尖从云雾般的高度缓缓落下。
“轰——”
一声沉闷的巨响在街区间炸开，海柠愣了一下，她低头看去，只见刚才还整齐排列的茅草屋已经完全塌成了一片碎木与泥土，白袜脚尖下则陷出一个浅浅的坑
而那些方才还在挥着农具的小人也已经完全看不见了
只剩下一些细碎的红点，在袜底与地面之间慢慢漫开。
“呜……”
她本能地把脚抬起来一点，
袜底黏着一点点细小的东西，看起来像是被踩碎的浆果。
她看了一会儿，脸忽然有点红，
“真的……踩死了。”
她小声嘀咕着，声音轻得像怕被谁听见一样，不过，200倍扩大的声音...却是让所有人都听的见呢
english:
“Huff, huff… Ah~ Ha”
Accompanied by a young girl’s yawn, Kaining slowly opened her eyes. Her lake-green eyes flickered as she searched for Qinwen, but she couldn’t find her. A faint, tickling sensation at her feet became too much for Kaining to bear, so she looked down...\ There lay an entire miniature town: ancient thatched huts, pavilions and towers in the distance, and a few farmers no bigger than insects, wielding farming tools and swinging them with all their might at Kaining’s little feet clad in white socks. Judging by the style, it looked like Qinwen’s handiwork, but Qinwen generally didn’t possess that kind of ability, so Kaining also—
 “Phew, this must be a dream...”
“If it’s a dream... then... I guess I can just stomp on them for fun...”\ nAccompanied by that gentle voice, the delicate white-socked feet—standing over 50 meters tall—shifted slightly, and those tiny farmers predictably became blood-red blossoms blooming beneath Kaining’s feet.
“Hmm… just like that… and they’re gone.”
“I killed someone… . Wait, this is a dream... Phew.”
“If this is a dream, then those buildings...”
As if to confirm her thoughts, Kaining, who had been lying on her side, sprang to her feet. And as soon as she stood— but the moment she stood, her 300-meter-tall body forced all the Tiny persons to their knees. After all, a height of 300 meters was an unimaginable scale in ancient times—with no airplanes and no skyscrapers, Kaining’s height at that moment was no different from that of a deity.
 “Phew, they’re all so tiny. I can’t even make them out unless I look closely... I’ll try taking a couple of steps first,” Kaining said as she cautiously shifted her foot. 
To her, the movement was nothing more than gently extending her foot forward—she hadn’t even fully lifted her ankle. But to the world below her, it was as if the entire sky had suddenly lowered; the tip of her foot, encased in a white sock, slowly descended from a height resembling the clouds.
“Boom—”\ nA muffled, thunderous roar exploded between the streets. Kaining froze for a moment. She looked down to see that the thatched cottages, which had been neatly arranged just moments ago, had completely collapsed into a pile of splintered wood and mud, while a shallow pit had formed beneath the tip of her white-socked foot\ nAnd the tiny persons who had been wielding their farming tools just moments ago were now completely out of sight. 
All that remained were a few scattered red dots, slowly spreading between the sole of her sock and the ground. 
“Ugh…”
She instinctively lifted her foot slightly.
A tiny speck was stuck to the sole of her sock—it looked like a crushed berry.
She stared at it for a moment, then her face suddenly flushed a little.
“I really… stepped on it.”\ nShe muttered under her breath, her voice so soft as if she were afraid someone might hear her—but with the sound amplified 200 times... everyone could hear her just fine.

不过很快，她又自己摇了摇头
“梦而已……梦而已……”
“在梦里应该没关系吧……”
说完这句话，她又低头看向脚下的世界，
刚才那一脚踩塌的地方，只占整条街的一小块。更远处还有很多小屋、田地、河流，还有密密麻麻像蚂蚁一样奔跑的小人。
他们显然已经看见了她。
很多人正朝着远处逃跑，也有一些人跪在地上，不停地磕头。
“他们……是在拜我吗？”
她蹲下来一点点，注视着下方的城市
光是这个动作，就让整个大地发出一阵沉重的震动，
“轰隆——”
地面裂开细细的缝隙，几座本就摇摇欲坠的房屋直接倒塌，海柠又僵住了。
“啊……对不起对不起……”
她连忙小声道歉，不过说完她又愣了一下
“等等……”
“我为什么要跟梦里的人道歉啊……”
她歪着头想了想，确实
如果这是梦的话，那不就像游戏一样吗~？
想到这里，她忽然有点好奇。
“那……再试一下~？”
她轻轻把脚抬起来，这一次，她看得很清楚
白袜包裹的小脚从天空一样的高度抬起，影子慢慢笼罩住一整片村落，那些小人似乎意识到了什么，他们开始疯狂四散奔逃。

大片房屋直接被压平，屋顶和墙壁像纸一样折断。尘土像雾一样升起来，顺着她的小腿缓缓散开。
海柠忍不住吸了一口气。
“哇……”
她低头看着脚下。
刚才那条街已经完全消失了。
只剩下一个巨大的脚印，她慢慢抬起脚，白袜底部沾着一点点深色的痕迹。
海柠盯着那痕迹看了好一会儿。
而后，她忽然轻轻笑了一下。
“真的像踩沙子一样呢……”
她的声音里多了一丝愉悦，最开始那种紧张和不安，好像慢慢淡了
远处的山丘，在她那300米的身高眼里不过像小土包一样，
河流像细细的线，而那些小人……已经小得几乎看不见了
少女轻轻抬起一只脚，在空中晃了晃

低声说着，轻轻向前迈了一步

大地再次剧烈震动
她这一脚直接跨过了半个村子
脚跟落在田地里，整片田垄被完完全全压扁，而脚尖则踩在另一条街上，房屋像被橡皮擦抹掉一样整排消失

她忽然忍不住笑出来。

她又迈了一步

白袜玉足缓缓落下
她甚至能看见脚影一点点盖住地面，小人像黑点一样四散奔逃

然后脚轻轻一压。

地面就像软泥一样塌陷。

她小声说到，但她并没有停下，反而又慢慢转了一圈。
裙摆在空中轻轻晃动，几座高一点的塔楼直接被吹倒了
海柠低头看着，
脸上渐渐露出一点点忍不住的笑
“原来……我这么大啊~要是秦雯在就好了”
“她肯定会说我又在胡闹。”
想到这里，她忽然有点不好意思，于是便对着那些注视着她的小人们落下了玉足

But soon, she shook her head again.
“It’s just a dream… just a dream…”
“It should be okay in a dream…”
After saying this, she looked down at the world beneath her feet.
The spot she’d just crushed with her foot was only a small part of the entire street. Further in the distance were many small houses, fields, rivers, and tiny people scurrying about like ants. 
They had clearly already spotted her. 
Many were fleeing into the distance, while others knelt on the ground, bowing their heads repeatedly. 
“Are they… worshipping me?”
She crouched down slightly, gazing at the city below. 
That single movement alone sent a heavy tremor rippling through the entire earth. 
“Boom—”\ n Fine cracks appeared in the ground, and several houses that were already on the verge of collapse came crashing down. Kaining froze again. 
“Ah… I’m sorry, I’m sorry…”
She hurriedly whispered an apology, but after speaking, she paused for a moment. 
“Wait a minute…” 
“Why am I apologizing to someone in a dream…?”
She tilted her head and thought about it—it made sense.
If this was a dream, wouldn’t it be just like a video game~?
With that thought, she suddenly felt a bit curious. 
“Then… should I try it again~?”
She gently lifted her foot. This time, she could see it clearly.
Her small foot, wrapped in white socks, rose to a height as high as the sky, and her shadow slowly engulfed the entire village. The tiny people seemed to realize something; they began to scatter frantically in all directions. 
Watching this scene, Kaining suddenly felt a little happy. 
“Um… I hope this isn’t going too far…”
She hesitated for a moment. 
Then—
Her foot came down. 
“BOOM!!”
This kick was much harder than the last one. 
A large section of houses was flattened outright, their roofs and walls snapping like paper. Dust rose like fog, slowly spreading out along her calves.
Kaining couldn’t help but gasp.
“Wow…”
She looked down at her feet. 
The street from moments ago had completely vanished.
All that remained was a giant footprint. She slowly lifted her foot; the bottom of her white sock was stained with a faint dark mark.
Kaining stared at the mark for quite a while.
Then, she suddenly smiled softly.
 “It really feels like stepping on sand…”
A hint of delight crept into her voice; the initial tension and unease seemed to be slowly fading.
From her height of 300 meters, the distant hills looked no bigger than small mounds of dirt,
rivers appeared as thin lines, and those tiny people… were so small they were almost invisible. 
The girl gently lifted one foot and wiggled it in the air. 
“So tiny… No wonder I didn’t notice them earlier.” 
She murmured softly, taking a gentle step forward. 
“Boom—”\ The earth shook violently once more.
With that single step, she had straddled half the village.
Her heel landed in a field, completely flattening the entire ridge of the furrow, while her toes touched down on another street, where rows of houses vanished as if erased by a rubber eraser.
“Eh…”\ n“I just took one step, that’s all~”
She suddenly couldn’t help but laugh.
“So this is what happens~”
She took another step.
“Boom—”
This time, she deliberately slowed down a bit. 
Her delicate feet in white socks slowly descended.
She could even see the shadow of her foot gradually covering the ground, as tiny persons scattered in all directions like black dots.
“Hmm…”
Kaining squinted and watched for a moment. 
Then she pressed down gently with her foot.
“Snap.”
She applied a slight pressure with the sole of her foot.
The ground caved in like soft mud.
“…That’s a little strange,”
she murmured, but she didn’t stop; instead, she slowly spun around again. 
The hem of her skirt fluttered gently in the air, and several of the taller towers were blown right over.
Kaining looked down,
a faint, uncontrollable smile gradually spreading across her face.
“So… I’m this big, huh~ I wish Qinwen were here.”
“She’d definitely say I’m just messing around again. ”
At that thought, she suddenly felt a bit embarrassed, so she lowered her jade-like foot toward the tiny persons staring at her.
“Boom!!”
She wiggled her foot slightly.
“It’s just a dream, anyway.”
This time, she didn’t hold back.
Her 300-meter-tall body moved slowly through the ancient city.

每一步都像神明落脚。
房屋、城墙、桥梁、田地……
在她脚下不断崩塌。
而海柠一开始那点小小的害羞和迟疑，也像雾一样慢慢散掉了呢
她低头看着脚下的世界。
轻声笑着说：
“这么小的世界……”
她抬起脚。
那带着丝丝少女清香的玉足再次覆盖一整片城镇
“踩起来真的很方便呢。”
“唔诶？！”
正当海柠准备再往前落足之时，她“娇小”的身体竟开始冒起了光芒
光芒持续的时间并不长。
海柠眨了眨眼，发现自己还站在原地。不，不对——不是站在原地，是站在这片已经面目全非的土地上。她下意识低头看去，然后...
那些原本像蚂蚁一样的小人，现在变得更小了。小到她必须眯起眼睛才能勉强辨认出那些移动的黑点。而周围的建筑……那些曾经还能被她一眼认出的茅草屋、塔楼、城墙，现在看起来就像一片片模糊的色块，杂乱地铺在地面上。
原本三百米的身高已经足够俯瞰整座城市，而现在，那些亭台楼阁在她眼中已经成了真正的蚂蚁窝。
海柠试着低头去找刚才踩过的街道，却发现自己根本看不清了——那条街，那个脚印，连同周围的一切，都已经缩成了一个模糊的小点。
“诶？”
海柠愣了一下，然后忽然笑了。
“又变大了呀~反正是做梦呢~”
她的声音从天空降下，像是闷雷滚过大地。那些侥幸逃过第一轮踩踏的小人们抬头望向天空，看见的是一个更加恐怖的景象——
天边，一个高耸入云的巨柱突然出现，他们需要把脖子仰到极限，才能勉强看到那巨大的轮廓。她的脸庞隐没在云端，只有那双湖绿色的眼睛注视着渺小的世界
海柠抬起手看了看。手掌摊开，就能遮住半边天。她轻轻翻动手腕，气流便在城市上空掀起一阵狂风，无数茅草屋的屋顶被掀飞，像纸片一样在空中打转
“唔，这风……”
她有些不好意思地缩了缩肩膀，但很快又忍不住笑起来。
“抱歉抱歉，我不是故意的~不过……”
她歪着头看向地面，那些小人在她眼中已经比尘埃大不了多少。她试着眯起眼聚焦，才勉强看见一些细小的黑点在移动。
“这么小，根本看不清嘛~”
她嘟囔着，忽然起了玩心。
“那……再试试看？”
她抬起脚，这次没有犹豫，直接踩了下去
“轰————！！！”
一声比之前任何一次都要沉闷的巨响。大地剧烈震颤，裂缝以她的脚为中心向四周蔓延，整整半个城区在这一脚下彻底消失。等她抬起脚，地面上留下了一个深达数米的巨大脚印，印底的泥土已经被压得瓷实发亮，完全看不出任何建筑的痕迹
“哇……”
海柠眨眨眼，盯着那个脚印看了好一会儿，然后忍不住笑出声来。
“真的完全看不见了诶。”
她迈开步子，开始在城中走动。每一步落下，都是一场灾难。房屋在她脚下粉碎，河流被她一脚踩断，河水倒灌进脚印形成的水坑。她走得很慢，像在散步，但每一步都让这座城市离毁灭更近一步呢
“嗯……那边有个塔？”
她注意到远处有一座高塔，似乎是这座城里最高的建筑。她好奇地走过去，等到了近前才发现，那塔还没有她的脚踝高了
“这么矮呀。”
她伸出食指，轻轻一推。
塔身拦腰折断，上半部分坠落下来，砸进旁边的民居，激起一片尘土。海柠看着这一幕，忽然觉得有点好笑了
少女缓缓蹲下——这个动作让整个地面又是一震——然后伸出一根手指，开始拨弄那些残存的建筑
手指轻轻一划，一条街就没了，变成了一个土黄色的条纹
指尖轻轻一点，一坐山就崩解了，变成了一个土黄色的条纹
english:
Every step was like a god setting foot on the ground. 
Houses, city walls, bridges, fields… 
They crumbled endlessly beneath her feet. 
And that little bit of shyness and hesitation Kaining had felt at the beginning slowly dissipated like mist. 
She looked down at the world beneath her feet. 
She chuckled softly:
“Such a tiny world…”
She lifted her foot.
That jade-like foot, carrying a faint, sweet, girlish scent, once again covered an entire town.
“It’s really convenient to walk on like this.”\ n“Huh?!”
Just as Kaining was about to take another step forward, her “petite” body suddenly began to glow.
The glow didn’t last long.
Kaining blinked and realized she was still standing in the same spot. No, wait—she wasn’t standing in the same spot; she was standing on this land that had been completely transformed. She instinctively looked down, and then...
The tiny people that had once looked like ants were now even smaller. So small that she had to squint to barely make out the moving black dots. And the surrounding buildings… the thatched huts, towers, and city walls that she had once been able to recognize at a glance now looked like blurry patches of color, scattered haphazardly across the ground. 
Her original height of three hundred meters had been enough to overlook the entire city, but now, those pavilions and towers had become nothing more than actual anthills in her eyes. 
Kaining tried to look down to find the street she’d just walked on, only to discover she couldn’t make it out at all—that street, that footprint, and everything around it had all shrunk into a tiny, blurry speck. 
“Huh?”
Kaining paused for a moment, then suddenly smiled.
“It’s getting bigger again~ It’s just a dream anyway~”
Her voice echoed down from the sky, like muffled thunder rolling across the earth. The tiny people who had narrowly escaped the first wave of trampling looked up at the sky and saw an even more terrifying sight—
On the horizon, a colossal pillar soaring into the clouds suddenly appeared; they had to crane their necks to the limit just to barely make out its massive outline. Her face was hidden in the clouds; only those lake-green eyes gazed down upon the tiny world. 
Kaining raised her hand to examine it. With her palm spread open, she could block out half the sky. She gently flicked her wrist, and a gust of wind swept through the city, tearing the roofs off countless thatched huts, which spun through the air like scraps of paper. 
“Hmm, this wind…”
She shrugged her shoulders slightly, looking a bit embarrassed, but soon couldn’t help but laugh. 
“Sorry, sorry, I didn’t mean to~ But…”
She tilted her head to look down at the ground; to her eyes, those tiny people were now little bigger than specks of dust. She tried squinting to focus and could barely make out some tiny black dots moving.
“They’re so small, I can’t even see them clearly~”\ nShe muttered, suddenly feeling playful.
“Well… shall I try again?”
She lifted her foot, and this time, without hesitation, stomped down.
“BOOM————!!!”
A thunderous roar, deeper and more muffled than any before.
 The ground shook violently, and cracks spread outward from the center of her foot; an entire half of the city vanished completely beneath that single step. When she lifted her foot, a massive footprint several meters deep remained on the ground. chinese:
通讯器那头沉默了片刻。
她没有立刻回应，只是静静地看着屏幕上逐帧回传的冰窟影像
勘探员小心翼翼地清理掉入口处的冰层，露出门楣上镌刻的一行古老文字时，秦雯的目光却骤然凝住了
那是一行用极古老的金文写成的短句，翻译过来，大意是
“此剑不染血，此身不称功。唯愿河山无恙，万民长安。”
刚才还在撒娇的天体极少女轻声念出这句话，语气中那些平日里的慵懒被一种罕见的沉静所取代
勘探队继续深入，打开了那扇被封冻的墓门。墓室内部并不奢华，只有一具保存完好的遗骸，身披素甲，手握一尊巨盾，安安静静地躺在石台之上，墓室四壁刻满了密密麻麻的铭文，记录着这位将军的一生
他曾在古国最混乱的纷争年代，统兵镇守边疆。彼时，敌国屡次犯境，边境百姓饱受战火之苦。然而他却在连战连胜、兵锋正盛之际，主动向敌国递出了求和书信，许以互市、通婚、共修水利之利。敌方统帅大为震动，回信询问其意。他只在信上写了一行字：
“吾所求者，非战功也。吾所求者，春耕时无人惊扰，秋收时无人焚粮，孩童不必在废墟中拾取箭镞。此即吾之战争。”
最终，双方罢兵休战，边境安宁五十余年。而他，却在一个寻常的冬夜，在戍边的营帐中静静地闭上了眼睛
他死得平静，轻于鸿毛，连学富五车的秦雯甚至都不知道他的故事
秦雯久久没有说话
最后，她轻轻摘下那副圆框眼镜，用衣角拭了拭镜片，又重新戴上。她抬起头，那双粉色的眼眸中只剩下一种清澈而深沉的敬意。她开口时，语气是那样郑重，那种带着古韵的、文绉绉的语调缓缓而口
“吾尝以为，战争者，乃文明之痼疾，不可避也。然观此将军生平，始知些许，战争之终，非在于杀戮之尽，而在于生民得安。其所求者，非胜也，乃民之安矣”
“此君以一己之罢兵，换得二十载河清海晏，吾辈生于星辰之间，动辄裂地摧城，却未必有此君之胸怀。诚惶诚恐，自愧不如”
她沉默了片刻，又轻轻笑了几声
“唉……这书，我今日怕是看不进去了。鄙人须亲往寒岭，祭拜此君，帝国的事务，还是放下为好”
english:
There was a moment of silence on the other end of the communicator. 
She didn’t respond immediately, but simply gazed silently at the frame-by-frame footage of the ice cave being transmitted back to her screen.
As the explorer carefully cleared away the ice at the entrance, revealing a line of ancient text engraved on the lintel, Qinwen’s gaze suddenly froze.
 nIt was a short phrase written in extremely ancient oracle bone script. Translated, it roughly meant
“This sword shall not be stained with blood; this life shall not claim glory. May the land remain unharmed, and may the people live in peace.”\ nThe young girl from the Celestial Realm, who had been acting coy just moments before, softly recited the phrase, her usual languid tone replaced by a rare sense of solemnity
The exploration team continued deeper, opening the frozen tomb door. The interior of the tomb was not lavish; it contained only a well-preserved set of remains. Clad in plain armor and clutching a massive shield, the figure lay peacefully upon a stone platform. The four walls of the tomb were covered with dense, intricate inscriptions chronicling the general’s life\ nDuring the most turbulent era of strife in the ancient kingdom, he had led troops to defend the frontier. At that time, enemy nations repeatedly invaded, and the people along the border suffered greatly from the ravages of war. Yet, at the height of his military success—having won battle after battle—he took the initiative to send a letter of peace to the enemy nation, offering the benefits of trade, intermarriage, and joint water conservancy projects. The enemy commander was deeply shaken and replied, asking for clarification of his intentions. He wrote only one line in his reply:\ n“What I seek is not military glory. What I seek is for people to be undisturbed while plowing in spring, for no one to burn their grain during the autumn harvest, and for children not to have to pick up arrowheads from the ruins. This is my war.”
In the end, both sides laid down their arms and agreed to a ceasefire, bringing peace to the borderlands for more than fifty years. Yet he, on an ordinary winter night, quietly closed his eyes in his border garrison tent
He died peacefully, as light as a feather; not even Qinwen, with her vast store of knowledge, knew his story
Qinwen remained silent for a long time\ nFinally, she gently removed her round-framed glasses, wiped the lenses with the corner of her sleeve, and put them back on. She looked up, and in her pink eyes there remained only a clear and profound sense of respect. When she spoke, her tone was solemn; that archaic, literary inflection flowed slowly from her lips
“I have always believed that war is a chronic ailment of civilization, one that cannot be avoided. Yet, upon observing this general’s life, I have come to understand, at least in part, that the end of war does not lie in the cessation of killing, but in the people finding peace. What he sought was not victory, but the people’s peace.”
“This man exchanged his own decision to lay down arms for twenty years of peace and tranquility. We, born among the stars, are quick to ravage the land and destroy cities, yet we may not possess his magnanimity. I am truly humbled and ashamed that I fall short of his example.”
She fell silent for a moment, then let out a few soft laughs.
“Ah… I’m afraid I won’t be able to concentrate on this book today. I must journey to Hanling myself to pay my respects to this man; it would be best to set aside the affairs of the empire for now.”

她沿着那条倾斜的冰道缓步而下，脚步声在空旷的冰窟中轻轻回荡。勘探队早已退出，将这片寂静完整地留给了她。当她站在那座墓室前，看着门楣上那行铭文时，突然停住了脚步，在那具素甲遗骸前站了很久。她没有开口，只是静静地看着那张安详的面容
“吾尝以为，战争者，不过是某些人的利益使然。吾以星海为盘，众生为子，胜者执棋，败者覆灭。然观此君遗骨，方知吾之所执，乃何等轻狂。”
“他从未以杀伐为荣。他所求的，不过是春耕时无人惊扰，秋收时无人焚粮，这六个字，便是他毕生之役。而吾辈……动辄以文明之名，行毁天灭地之事，却未曾想过，那双双被碾碎于足下的蝼蚁，所求的，也不过如此罢了”

少女直起身，转身向外走去，走到墓室门口时，又微微顿住，侧过头，轻声补了一句

那声音散入寒冰之中，被刺骨的冷风卷走
而秦雯的心中，一个小小的火种竞成燎原之势，彻底改变了她的想法

english:
She had actually come—and she was of a rare, normal build.
She walked slowly down the sloping ice path, her footsteps echoing softly in the vast ice cavern. The exploration team had long since withdrawn, leaving this silence entirely to her. When she stood before the burial chamber, gazing at the inscription on the lintel, she suddenly stopped in her tracks and stood for a long time before the remains clad in plain armor. She said nothing, merely gazing quietly at the serene face.
“I once believed that war was nothing more than the result of certain people’s self-interest. I viewed the starry sea as a chessboard and all living beings as pieces—the victor holds the pieces, while the vanquished are annihilated. Yet, gazing upon this man’s remains, I now realize just how reckless my own convictions have been.”
“He never took pride in slaughter. All he sought was for no one to disturb the spring plowing, and for no one to burn the grain during the autumn harvest—these six words were the cause of his entire life’s struggle. Yet we… so readily commit acts of utter destruction in the name of civilization, without ever considering that the ants crushed beneath our feet sought nothing more than this.”\ nShe stood up, took a step back, smoothed her robe once more, and bowed solemnly with her hands clasped. 
“I, Qinwen, who takes the sounds of birds and the beauty of mountains and rivers as my emblem, am but a humble lover of wine and books; my lifelong passion has been nothing more than a volume of poetry and prose. Yet today, having witnessed the legacy of this gentleman, I realize how shallow I truly am. From now on, I shall take this as a lesson—to fight with caution and to feel remorse when taking a life.”
The young woman straightened up and turned to walk out. When she reached the entrance to the tomb chamber, she paused briefly, turned her head, and added softly,
“Thank you for your guidance.”\ nThe sound faded into the ice, swept away by the bone-chilling wind. 
But within Qinwen’s heart, a tiny spark had ignited into a raging wildfire, completely transforming her way of thinking. 
“This time, I will protect everyone.” 
At that very moment, we received a communication request from Qinwen.
Get connected right away!

少女歪过头，那张占据了小半个通讯屏幕的脸庞上，浮现出一抹熟悉的、带着几分戏谑的笑容。那双粉色的眼眸微微眯起，语气轻飘飘的，仿佛刚才那段庄重的感悟从未发生过一般
“啊哈~指挥官阁下，别那么紧张嘛~这颗星球反正也是荒芜的，我捏着玩一玩又不会怎么样啦~”
她说着，又轻轻捏了捏那星球的两极，地壳发出一阵清脆的碎裂声
“刚才说的那句话，我可是认真的哦~‘这一次，我会保护所有人’”
她顿了顿，指尖轻轻一旋，那颗星球在她指间缓慢转动
“所以——指挥官阁下，我想成为你们的舰娘”

她的指尖微微一用力——那颗荒芜星球终于在她指间彻底碎裂，化作一片尘埃，而她那巨大的、笼罩星辰的身影，正等待着我们的答复
娘对帝国来说是十足珍贵的资源，我们费劲巴力制造的各种舰队，在这天体级少女的玉指之下，也撑不过一秒，而秦雯所拥有的力量，如果为我们所用，那对我们来说将是如虎添翼，毕竟，她只需要吹几口气，踩下几脚，就能对整个星糸造成重创，更何况，她还拥有巨大化的能力
english:
The moment the communication request was established, a vast starry sky appeared on the screen. Amid the starlight, a silhouette so immense it took one’s breath away slowly unfolded
Qinwen had already regained her majestic, celestial-scale form\ nWith a single finger, she was gently pinching the two poles of a barren planet; her fingertip sank slightly into the crust. The planet groaned under the strain between her fingers, and spiderweb-like cracks began to spread across its surface\ nThe young woman tilted her head; a familiar, slightly mischievous smile appeared on her face, which filled nearly half the communication screen. Her pink eyes narrowed slightly, and her tone was light and carefree, as if the solemn reflection from moments ago had never happened
 “Ah ha~ Commander, don’t be so tense~ This planet is barren anyway; it won’t hurt to just play with it a little~”
As she spoke, she gently pinched the planet’s poles again, and the crust emitted a crisp cracking sound.
 “I was serious about what I said earlier, you know~ ‘This time, I’ll protect everyone.’”
She paused for a moment, then gave her fingertips a gentle twist, causing the planet to spin slowly between her fingers.
 “So—Commander, I’d like to become one of your Fleet Girls.”
“What do you think? Taking in a ‘Fleet Girl’ who loves drinking, reading, and occasionally crushing a planet or two to pass the time… isn’t too bad a deal, is it~?”\ nWith a slight squeeze of her fingertips—the barren planet finally shattered completely between her fingers, turning to dust, while her immense figure, shrouding the stars, awaited our response
Shipgirls are an invaluable resource to the Empire; the various fleets we’ve painstakingly built, wouldn’t last a second under the delicate fingers of this celestial-scale maiden. If we could harness Qinwen’s power, it would be like adding wings to a tiger. After all, she only needs to blow a few breaths or stomp a few times to inflict severe damage on the entire Stellar Thread—not to mention, she also possesses the ability to grow to gigantic proportions.

english:
The Empire’s top engineering team had been waiting in orbit for a full half hour. When Qinwen’s massive figure slowly descended from the starry sky, all the staff members instinctively held their breath\ nAlthough they had seen images of her countless times, the overwhelming sense of awe they felt upon witnessing a celestial-level young woman’s form straddling their homeworld was still something no words could convey. 
She hovered in the center of the hangar, her arms slightly outstretched, cooperating with the staff as they took measurements. Her pale, jade-like legs hung naturally downward, and her enormous pink sneakers were almost touching the homeworld—and if they were to actually make contact, it would spell utter disaster for the entire Empire.\ nThe Chief Engineer stood on the command tower, looking up at the figure that nearly obscured half the dome of the spaceport. 
Heavy alloy armor plates were slowly hoisted into the air by a giant crane. Each of these armor plates was as large as half a city and thick enough to withstand the bombardment of a flagship’s main guns. Yet when they were hoisted in front of Qinwen, they seemed insignificant in comparison to her massive frame.\ nQinwen tilted her head slightly to glance at the armor plate about to be secured to her shoulder blade. She blinked and whispered with a hint of curiosity
“Hmm… won’t this be a bit heavy to wear?”\ n“Rest assured, Miss Qinwen,” the chief engineer’s voice came through the communicator, tinged with a touch of nervous deference. “The armor has been lightweighted and won’t hinder your movements.”
“That’s good to hear~”

“唔…”秦雯看着那两杖“戒指”，微微眯起那双粉色的眼眸，语气中带着一丝毫不掩饰的嫌弃，“这东西……是不是有点华而不实啊？”
我们的总工程师一愣：“秦雯小姐，这是我们帝国最新型的轨道速射炮，威力足以一炮摧毁一整支舰队——”
“我知道我知道。”秦雯摆了摆手，那动作带起的风压让整座船坞的照明灯都剧烈晃动，她低下头，那双巨大的粉瞳凑近指挥塔，带着几分慵懒的笑意轻声道：“但是啊——指挥官阁下，您觉得我捏碎一颗星球需要用几秒钟呢~？”
秦雯抬起一只手，纤细修长的手指在星空中缓缓屈伸，瞬间，一颗无辜的小行星就成了少女指间的尘埃“与其装上这么多笨重的火炮，不如让我用这根手指，轻轻弹一下——效果不比您的炮差喔~。”
总工程师的额头渗出一层冷汗，但依然坚持道：“秦雯小姐，这是帝国舰娘的标准装配流程，请您配合——”
“好啦好啦，装就装吧~”秦雯叹了口气，语气中带着几分宠溺的无奈，“就当是戴个戒指啦~”
english:
As the work progressed, more and more armor plates were installed on her torso and limbs. The white coat was gradually covered by silver-gray armor; her arms, chest, sides, knees, and even ankles were all covered with layer upon layer of precision-crafted, sturdy alloy armor. Although the thickness and weight of the armor were enough to crush an entire army, on her magnificent, celestial-scale frame, it looked no more than a beautiful new outer garment. 
Next came the installation of the artillery. 
Two colossal railguns rose slowly into the air, guided by giant mechanical arms. Each barrel of those two main cannons was large enough to accommodate a destroyer passing through it, and the diameter of the muzzles even exceeded that of the Empire’s grandest parliamentary dome—yet, in the eyes of the colossal, celestial-class girl, they were nothing more than two ring-shaped objects
 “Hmm…” Qinwen looked at those two “rings,” narrowing her pink eyes slightly, her tone carrying a hint of undisguised disdain. “Aren’t these… a bit flashy but impractical?”\ nOur chief engineer was taken aback: “Miss Qinwen, this is our Empire’s latest orbital rapid-fire cannon. Its firepower is sufficient to destroy an entire fleet with a single shot—”\ n“I know, I know.” Qinwen waved her hand; the air pressure from the gesture caused all the lights in the entire drydock to sway violently. She lowered her head, bringing her enormous pink eyes close to the command tower, and whispered with a hint of lazy amusement, “ “But—Your Excellency, the Commander, how many seconds do you think it would take me to crush a planet~?”\ nQinwen raised a hand, her slender, long fingers slowly flexing against the starlit sky. In an instant, an innocent little asteroid became nothing more than dust between the girl’s fingers. “Instead of mounting all those clunky cannons, why not let me just flick it gently with this finger—the effect won’t be any worse than your cannons, you know~.”\ nA bead of cold sweat formed on the Chief Engineer’s forehead, but he persisted: “Miss Qinwen, this is the standard outfitting procedure for Imperial Ship Girls. Please cooperate—”\ n“All right, all right, I’ll install them then~” Qinwen sighed, her tone tinged with a touch of indulgent resignation. “Just think of it as putting on a ring~”

chinese:
在我们不辞辛劳的营建后，对天体级文学少女的改造终于成攻，而她，现在正在母星前，接受人民的检阅
她轻轻活动了一下那两枚“戒指”——那两门足以摧毁整支舰队的巨型轨道炮在她的指间微微转动，炮门正对着母星，引起了一阵恐慌
她听到那些从地面传来的、穿过大气层、微弱却热烈的呼唤声
“嗯…被这么多人看着，感觉有点害羞~好像吓到小家伙们了”
她说着，却并没有躲避那些目光，反而微微侧过头，将自己的脸庞正对着母星的方向。那张巨大的、精致的面容庞在星光与星港灯光的映照下泛着光芒，如同神明一般
她缓缓抬起纤手，指尖轻触唇边，做了一个飞吻的动作，而她没注意的是，有几滴飞沫砸向了星球
“嗨~小家伙们~”
她的声音透过通讯器，被转播到母星各地的公共频道中。那声音轻柔而带着一丝俏皮，像是一位邻家姐姐在窗台边朝着楼下的孩子们招手
地面上，爆发出一阵更加热烈的欢呼声，少女的几滴飞沫化作了最大的湖泊，让干旱地区几十年不愁水
她甚至低下头，将那张巨大的脸庞稍微压低了一些，让那些地面上的人们能够更清晰地看到她的面容
“好啦好啦，别一直盯着人家看啦~”她带着几分故作娇嗔的语气轻声道，“不过嘛……如果你们愿意的话，以后每次我执行完任务回来，都可以在星港这边跟大家打个招呼呀~”
秦雯开朗的笑容传入了每一个人的心尖，有这样温柔且强大的舰娘领袖，帝国定会如虎添翼
english:
After our tireless efforts, the transformation of the Celestial-Class Literary Girl has finally been successful, and she now stands before her homeworld, receiving a review from the people. nShe gently moved those two “rings”—the two massive orbital cannons capable of destroying an entire fleet—which rotated slightly between her fingers, their barrels pointing directly at the homeworld, causing a wave of panic.
She heard the faint yet passionate cries rising from the surface, piercing through the atmosphere.
 “Hmm… It feels a little embarrassing to be watched by so many people~ I think I’ve scared the little ones.”
As she spoke, she did not avert her gaze; instead, she tilted her head slightly, turning her face directly toward her homeworld. That enormous, exquisite face glowed in the light of the stars and the stardock’s lights, like that of a deity. 
She slowly raised her slender hand, lightly touched her lips with her fingertips, and blew a kiss—unaware that a few droplets of saliva had splashed onto the planet. 
 “Hey~ little ones~”
Her voice came through the communicator and was broadcast to public channels across the homeworld. Her voice was soft and tinged with a touch of playfulness, like a neighbor’s older sister waving to the children below from her windowsill.
On the ground, an even more enthusiastic cheer erupted. The few droplets from the young woman’s breath transformed into the largest lake, ensuring that the arid regions would have no shortage of water for decades.
 nShe even tilted her head down, lowering her enormous face slightly so that the people on the ground could see her features more clearly
“All right, all right, stop staring at me~” she whispered with a touch of feigned petulance, “ “But… if you’d like, every time I return from a mission, I can stop by Starport to say hello to everyone~”
Qinwen’s cheerful smile touched everyone’s hearts. With such a gentle yet powerful leader among the Ship Girls, the Empire would surely be even stronger.

chinese:
在全境冰封的宁古塔星系中，仍存有几颗宜居的行星。 在我们不辞辛劳的建设下，数颗星球被相继改造，安置了大量人口，极大缓解了其它星系的人口危机。而秦雯——那位巨大的文学少女，此刻正真真切切地坐在这颗星球的商场顶层，悠然地享受着午后的惬意
平日里天体级大小的秦雯如今却只有几十米的身高
“酒，乃文明之源啊。” 她举起那只宛如山丘般的巨大酒杯，琥珀色的液体在耀眼的阳光中泛着金灿灿的光泽“没有酒，又哪来如此美妙的文明”
她那微醺粉眸的微微眯起，带着三分陶醉与慵懒，垂眸望向脚下的街道。那双粉白交织的巨大运动鞋，恰好悬停在商场底层的广场上方，双腿随着呼吸晃动，而厚实洁净的鞋底——对于底下那些如同蝼蚁般渺小的文明子民而言，就是一整片遮天蔽日的穹顶
秦雯忽然有些玩心大起
她嘴角勾起一抹淡笑，轻轻晃了晃腿，巨大的鞋底在低空中掠过，气流将下方广场上的灰尘与落叶卷得四散飞舞。小人们惊慌失措地尖叫着四散奔逃，却被那宽阔的橡胶鞋底投下的阴影尽数笼罩
“哎呀呀，小家伙们跑到挺快~”她带着几分醉意喃喃自语，缓缓将那只包裹着白袜的脚踝向下探去——用鞋沿，轻轻在广场边缘的砖地上擦了一下
只是这么一个极其微不足道的逗弄动作，对底下的小人而言却是一场遮天盖地的惊涛骇浪。巨大的摩擦带动着一阵强风，几名跑得慢的小人直接被鞋侧刮起的气流掀倒在地，连滚带爬地翻出了好几米远
秦雯却仿佛浑然不觉，只是露出一个少女般天真又略带顽劣的笑容。她重新将巨足悬高，将那带有柔软粉色纹路的鞋底轻轻踮了踮，让底下的小人在她鞋底阴影的笼罩下惊惧不安地抬头仰望
“居高临下地看着文明在脚底繁荣、尖叫、四处逃窜…似乎比书本上的故事更加下酒呢~” 她惬意地灌下一大口麦酒，甘甜的液体顺着她白皙的下巴洒落在商场楼顶，将几只小人淹在了酒液中
english:
In the Ningguta Star System, which is entirely frozen over, there are still a few habitable planets. Through our tireless efforts, several of these planets have been successively transformed and settled by a large population, greatly alleviating the population crisis in other star systems. And Qinwen—that colossal literary maiden—is now sitting right here on the top floor of this planet’s shopping mall, leisurely savoring the pleasant afternoon. 
Qinwen, who is usually the size of a celestial body, is now only a few dozen meters tall. 
“Wine is the source of civilization,” She raised her enormous wine glass, which resembled a hill; the amber liquid shimmered with a golden glow in the dazzling sunlight. “Without wine, how could such a wonderful civilization have come to be?”\ nHer slightly tipsy, rosy eyes narrowed ever so slightly, radiating a mix of rapture and languor, as she cast her gaze down at the street below. Her enormous sneakers, a blend of pink and white, hovered directly above the plaza on the ground floor of the mall. Her legs swayed with each breath, and the thick, pristine soles—to the citizens of civilization below, who seemed as tiny as ants—formed a vast dome that blocked out the sky. nQinwen suddenly felt a surge of playfulness
A faint smile tugged at the corners of her mouth as she gently swayed her legs; the massive sole swept through the low sky, and the resulting air currents sent dust and fallen leaves swirling wildly across the plaza below. The tiny people screamed in panic and scattered in all directions, only to be completely engulfed by the shadow cast by that wide rubber sole.
“Oh my, you tiny ones sure can run fast~” She muttered to herself, slightly tipsy, and slowly lowered the ankle encased in a white sock—gently scraping the edge of the shoe against the brick pavement at the edge of the square\ nYet this utterly trivial, playful gesture was, to the tiny persons below, a sky-shattering, earth-shattering storm. The intense friction generated a powerful gust of wind; several of the slower tiny people were knocked to the ground by the airflow sweeping from the side of her shoe, tumbling and scrambling several meters away
Qinwen, however, seemed completely oblivious, merely flashing a girlish smile—innocent yet slightly mischievous. She raised her giant foot once more, gently tiptoeing on the sole adorned with soft pink patterns, causing the tiny people below to look up in fear and anxiety as they were enveloped by the shadow cast by her shoe
 “Looking down from on high as civilization flourishes, screams, and scatters beneath my feet… seems like an even better accompaniment to my drink than the stories in books~” She took a leisurely, large gulp of ale; the sweet liquid trickled down her fair chin and splashed onto the mall’s rooftop, drowning several Tiny people in the beer.

chinese: 快，趁着她没喝醉，赶紧转移所有人
english: Hurry up—while she’s still sober—and get everyone out of here.

chinese:
舰船的引擎轰鸣声在稀薄的大气中渐渐远去，最后一批运输船拖着长长的尾焰刺入云层。那座曾经熙熙攘攘的星球此刻彻底陷入了死寂
她粉色的眼眸半眯着，带着酒精浸润后的迷离与慵懒。她俯视着下方那空无一人的城市，轻巧地、带着一丝玩味地笑了一声~
“哎呀~真是迫不及待呢，这么快就把所有人都转移了呀~”
少女缓缓抬起一只手，将那白皙如玉指尖轻轻搭在城市边缘的地面上，指尖陷进泥土和钢筋混凝土之中，发出沉闷的咔嚓声。她歪了歪头，轻声道
“那阁下是打算给我创造一个游乐园吗~？” 她的声音变得轻快起来“那鄙人就恭敬不如从命了呢~”
话音刚落——伴随着一声低沉的的轰鸣，她又开始再次巨大化
是的，明明已经是巨大的存在，她仍毫不客气地继续膨胀。她的手指变得更加宏伟，身躯在群山间展开，原本被她的体重压垮的城市变成了山峦，她的小腿和脚踝在云层中不断延伸，那粉蓝相间的运动鞋如今已经大得足以让整条河流从鞋底绕道而行了呢
少女俯身将脸颊贴近地面，那双迷醉的粉瞳几乎贴上了其中一座摩天大楼的塔尖
“唔…这个世界一下子变得好小好小，像是我书桌上那座精致的微缩模型一样呢。”
伸出舌尖轻轻舔了舔嘴角残留的麦酒香气，随即把那根犹如巍峨山脉般的手指~轻轻~缓缓地按在了一座街区上
“那……我可要好好地、慢慢地玩一玩这座游乐园了呢~”
她将身体缓缓撑起，巨大的身躯在星球的地平线上投下了一道几乎横跨半球的阴影。山峦在她身下变成了起伏的丘陵，而她那一双巨大而厚重的运动鞋鞋底，正悬停在原本是最繁华城市核心区的上空
而，酒过三巡，秦雯脸上的红晕更甚
english:
The roar of the ships’ engines gradually faded into the thin atmosphere, and the last batch of transport ships, trailing long plumes of exhaust, plunged into the clouds. The planet, once bustling with life, was now plunged into complete silence.
Her pink eyes were half-closed, their gaze hazy and languid from the alcohol. She looked down at the deserted city below and let out a light, slightly amused chuckle~
“Oh my~ I can’t wait—they’ve evacuated everyone so quickly~”\ nThe young girl slowly raised one hand, gently resting her jade-white fingertip on the ground at the edge of the city. Her fingertip sank into the soil and reinforced concrete, emitting a dull crack. She tilted her head slightly and murmured
“So, are you planning to create an amusement park for me, Your Excellency~?” Her voice took on a lighter tone. “In that case, I shall humbly comply~”\ nNo sooner had the words left her mouth—accompanied by a low rumble—than she began to grow even larger once more
Yes, even though she was already a colossal presence, she continued to expand without hesitation. Her fingers grew even more colossal, and her body spread out among the mountains. The city, which had originally been crushed under her weight, had now transformed into mountain ranges. Her calves and ankles stretched endlessly into the clouds, and her pink-and-blue sneakers were now so enormous that an entire river had to detour around the soles. nThe girl leaned down, pressing her cheek close to the ground; her dreamy pink eyes were almost touching the spire of one of the skyscrapers.
“Hmm… The world has suddenly become so small, just like that exquisite miniature model on my desk.”\ nShe stuck out the tip of her tongue and gently licked away the lingering scent of wheat beer from the corner of her mouth, then pressed that finger—as massive as a mountain range—~gently~ and slowly onto a city block
 “Well… I’m going to have some fun—slowly and thoroughly—at this amusement park~”
She slowly raised herself up, her massive form casting a shadow across the planet’s horizon that spanned nearly half the hemisphere. The mountains beneath her had turned into rolling hills, and the soles of her massive, heavy sneakers hovered above what had once been the bustling heart of the city.
And after a few rounds of drinks, the flush on Qinwen’s face grew even deeper.

english: It's a good thing we acted quickly—it was truly shocking.

chinese:
“啊~应该是没人了吧~”
她慵懒地打了个酒嗝，那带着浓郁麦芽香气的气息拂过星球表面，将原本漂浮在低空的一层云吹得干干净净，露出下方更加清晰的城市废墟
“唔…这个姿势感觉还挺不错的~”
秦雯眯着那双半醉的紫瞳，轻轻撑起身子，就让自己那对惊人柔软的胸膛，缓缓地膨胀，成长，使原来贫瘠的胸部变得傲人、又带着几分戏谑的力道，压在了原本是星球最繁华的一片大陆上
那双巨大的、饱满的乳肉，在一片城市群上缓缓下压。动作优雅，令人气血上涌，甚至带着一种少女般漫不经心的轻巧——然而当她那柔软的胸腹触碰到地表时，数百平方公里的钢铁丛林使无声无息地陷入、碎裂、化作齑粉，接着被那层白皙的皮肤和衣料彻底掩埋
她低头看了一眼自己身下那片被压扁的“小方块”，流露出一种支配般的纯粹愉悦~
“这一片全被压平了呢~”
而她丝毫没有要起身的意思，反而用那双撑着地面的手臂微微移动了一下重心，让那对柔软如绵云般的胸脯在废墟上轻轻揉了揉
原本还有几座残留的摩天大楼尖顶，在那阵“轻柔的揉搓”中彻底被碾进了地壳里。而在她的乳晕与地表贴合的区域边缘，由于巨大的重量和挤压，地面像波浪般向四周隆起，形成了一圈足以延伸到地平线外的环形山脉
“好像~那边还没被姐姐恩泽过呀~”
她用那双撑着地面的手臂微微用力，将巨大的身子在星球表面挪动了几十公里——那动作对她只是慵懒地在翻了个身，但对这颗星球而言，却是大陆板块间一场毁灭性的剧变了。
柔软的双乳在地面上碾过，将原本便已破碎的城市废墟彻底碾成了一道光滑的、略带弧度的凹痕，余波将地壳深处的地下水挤压出来，淹没一切
她又翻过身来，以一个半躺半坐的姿势，将自己那对巨大的胸部再次悬停在那片沿海平原上方，然后，带着一种极其天真的，玩闹般的轻快揉捏着巨大的乳首...
“嘿咻~”
她发出一个带着醉意的、软绵绵的语气词，而她胸前那两颗挺立的乳首也沂出了几滴乳汁
这次她仅仅是借着酒精带来的松弛感，将身体的重量自然而然地沉降下去。然而那足以承载她庞大身躯的柔韧胸部，却以一种温柔得近乎残忍的方式，将整片沿海平原上的高楼大厦全都淹没
那些曾经精密的高塔和工业设施，在她胸口的压迫下，将一切轻轻抹平，只留下了一层浅浅的、带着她体温和衣料纹理的白色深坑
她似乎对这个结果十分满意，甚至轻轻扭了扭腰肢，用那已经被压扁得几乎可以反射阳光的大地作为支撑，调整了一个更舒服的姿势——那双巨大的运动鞋在空中晃荡着，又被她晃下来，将远处几座尚未倒塌的孤峰碾得粉碎，碎屑洒落在她身下那片早已面目全非的大地上...
“唉…果然不能喝太多呢~，一不小心就会做出点…嗯~…稍微~有点过分的事情呢~”
“大家好不容易建的东西都被姐姐我压坏了...那就给这颗小星球…一个温柔的~巨大的抱抱当补偿吧~”


话音刚落——她的身形便再次开始膨胀。
那是如此优雅而无声的成长，原来支配大陆的玉体这一次遮蔽着星球
english:
“Ah~ I guess no one’s around anymore~”
She let out a lazy burp; the breath, carrying a rich malt aroma, swept across the planet’s surface, blowing away the layer of clouds that had been hovering low in the sky and revealing the city ruins below in even greater detail.
 “Hmm… this position feels pretty good~”
Qinwen narrowed her half-drunken purple eyes, gently propping herself up, allowing her astonishingly supple breasts to slowly swell, growing, transforming her once-barren chest into a proud, almost mocking mass that pressed down upon what had once been the planet’s most prosperous continent.
Those enormous, full breasts slowly descended upon the urban landscape. Her movements were elegant, stirring the blood, and even carried a girlish, carefree lightness—yet when her soft chest and abdomen touched the ground, hundreds of square kilometers of the steel jungle sank silently, shattered, and turned to dust, then completely buried beneath that layer of fair skin and fabric

我们的科学家在风暴中心发现了一个不稳定的空间裂隙，这种裂隙会将两个遥远的空间链接起来，由于两头的裂隙并不一样大，通过该裂隙的物质流动都会因空间扭曲而被放大或缩小数十万倍，换句话说，那些正在被汗液风暴席卷的星系，此刻也栖居在某位巨娘的腋下。

此前为了应对汗液潮，我们将天灾管制限制在室外体育项目，所以她们转入室内继续训练
显然她不知道那场影响数个星系的宏大风暴，竟然是来自自己运动时的汗水

为了减少她出汗的可能，帝国行政部将天灾管制范围扩大到全部体育赛事，让这个姑娘和其同学的体育训练量控制在基础水平，闲下来的她们可以重心放在理论学习上。

The investigation into the source of the sweat storm has been a success!
Our scientists discovered an unstable spatial rift at the center of the storm—a rift that connects two distant points in space. Since the two ends of the rift are not the same size, the flow of matter passing through it is magnified or shrunk by hundreds of thousands of times due to spatial distortion. In other words, the galaxies currently being swept up by the sweat storm are, at this very moment, nestled in the armpit of a Giantess. 
Our research vessel has successfully pinpointed the coordinates of the other end of the rift; it appears the rift’s entrance has materialized on the body of a student from a sports academy who has come to one of our colonies. 
When our research vessel entered to investigate, this female student was resting. 
Previously, to cope with the sweat tide, we had restricted natural disaster controls to outdoor sports, so they had moved indoors to continue training\ nClearly, she had no idea that the massive storm affecting several galaxies actually originated from her own sweat during exercise. 
As she was about to finish her rest and resume training, the research vessel quickly accelerated away from the armpit world. A few minutes later, another wave of fresh sweat surged out of the spatial rift. 
To reduce the likelihood of her sweating, the Imperial Administration expanded the natural disaster restrictions to cover all athletic events, limiting the physical training of this girl and her classmates to a basic level so that, with their free time, they could focus on theoretical studies. 
Our scientists predict that this rift is unstable and will close completely within a few months to a few years. However, the sweat storms that have already been poured into the Milky Way through the portal can only be left to time to resolve.
